༄7//dpal ldan glang nag dgon pa'i rdo rje slob dmen chen mo 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rin chen mchog gi mdzad rnam rags tsam brjod pa dri med gangs ri'i rang mdangs/tshe ring dbang rgyal gyis brtsams/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dkar chaga'ago brjod/ (1)dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma lnga'i rnam thar bsdus pa ngo mtshar rin chen phreng ba/ (1)thog mar sa chen kun dga' snying po/ (1)slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo (6)rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ (9)sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ (13)'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ (18)dang po/ dpal ldan glang nag dgon pa'i byung ba bsdus tsam brjod pa puṇ+ḍa ri ba'i do shal/ (26)gdan rabs dang po/ mkhyen rab dge 'phel/ (27)gdan rabs gnyis pa/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ (28)gdan rabs gsum pa/ snyan grags bstan pa'i dbang lcu/ga (28)gdan rabs bzhi pa/ 'jam dbyangs kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ (31)gdan rabs lnga pa/ kun dga' 'jam dbyangs snyan

grags bstan pa'i rgyal mazurgan/ (33)gdan rabs drug pa/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' snyan grab/ba/ / (34)gnyis pa/ dpal ldan sa skya nas bla bskos rim pa phebs tshul gser ri'i phreng ba/ (35)gsum pa/ dgon pa'i dus mchod kun gsal me long / (36)bzhi pa/ bka' drin can gyi bla ma rnam gnyis kyi mdzad bsdus dad pa'i 'dab brgya ba'ad pa'i dga' tshal/ (38)lnga pa/ snga dus kyi bshad grwa'i skor mdo tsam brjod pa/ (42)drug pa/ dpal ldan glang nag dgon pa'i mkhan rabs rim pa byon pa g.yu yi zeng ba/ (44)bdun pa/ mkhan rabs lnga pa bla ma bsod nams dbang 'dus rin po che/ (45)brgyad pa/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rin chen gyi mdzad rnam dung dkar sgra dbyangs/ (49)e waṃ 'dzam gling bkra shis dgon gyi lo rgyus bsdus tsam pad+ma dkar po'i chun po/ (67)bshad sgrub gnyis kyi srol ji ltar tshugs tshul/ (70)dgon 'di'i tshogs rten dang sgrub 'dzugs gtong sgo sogs kyi skor/ (71)dbon sde gzhan dang 'brel tshul/ (72)2

phyis kyi gnas tshul 'ga' zhis (72)phur mgo dgon gyi lo rgyus bsil zer dkar po'i thigs phreng / (74)sgrub mchod/ (74)deng gi gnas tshul/ (75)dgon pa'i las sne'i skor/ (76)kha non dgon pa'i lo rgyus mdo tsam brjod nga/ mu tig star la brgyus pa/ (76)gdan rabs/ (77)khri rabs/ (77)sgrub mchod/ (78)bshad sgrub kyi skor/ (79)mjug byang / (81)zur bkod/ (84)dpyad gzhi'i yig cha'i skor/ (87)

'go brjod/grub brgya'i spyi mes dpal ldan bir wa pa'i/ /gdams pa'i zab gnad gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi/ /bka' babs gdams pa'i gsang mdzod sa skya pa'i/ /rje btsun gong ma rnam lnga'i zhabs la 'dud/ /zhi dar mdun zhol mthong grol gling dgon du/ /rgyal bstan gsal ba'i nyi ma rim byon gyi/ /rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa la/ /lha dang bla mas shis pa'i me tog stsol/ /'phags pa rgya nag byon pa'i lam bar ru/ /phyag btab mngon sum mdzad nas da lta'i bar/ /grub pa'i skyes mchog zam ma chad pa'i gnas/ /e waṃ chos sde'i byung rim mdo tsam gleng / /sa skya'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i phur mgo dang / /kha non dgon pa gnyis kyi bstan pa la/ /phan pa 'byung nges dung skad gsar pa zhig /thos te 'di na 'god pa'i las la spro/ /de ltar tshigs su bcad pa'i sdun bsus te thog mar dpal 1

ldan sa skya pa zhes mtshan snyan dbyar gyi rnga gsang phyogs bcu'i tha gru kun tu yongs su khyab gnas pa de nyid kyi bstan pa'i srog shing chen po rje btsun gong ma lnga'i rnam par thar ba mdo tsam bsdus pa la don lnga yi sgo nas legs par shes pa bya'o/ /

dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rje bcun gong ma lnga'i rnam par thar ba bsdus pa ngo mtshar rin chen phreng ba/de yang skabs 'dir rgyal bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' bdag 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i gong ma rnam lnga'i rnam par thar pa skra rtse'i chu thigs tsam brjod par bya ba la/thog mar sa chen kun dga' snying po/khong ni bod rab byung gnyis pa'i chu sprel te spyi lo 1092lor kha ba can gyi sa'i cha 'di la dum bu gsum du gnas pa las bar gyi cha/ ru bzhi'i cha las ru lag gtsang stod grom pa'i yul gyi stod du yab 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dang / yum ma cig zhang mo gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te sku 'khrungs shing /sku 'khrungs ma thag nas gnam kha'u pas sku pang du bzhes te nges par spyan ras gzigs yin pa'i bsngags brjod mdzad nas mtshan kun dga' snying po zhes gsol/ yab kyi drung nas thun mong gi klog dang yig rtsis sogs 'jig rten dang mthun pa'i rgyal po dang blon po'i lugs kyi bstan bcos brtag pa rnam brgyad sogs la mkhas 1

par sbyangs/ dgung lo bcu gcig par yab gshegs nas ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags pa zhes bya ba'i zhabs kyi pad mo nye bar bsnyen te pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung lugs la 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa dang / sangs rgyas phal po che'i gzhung rab tu dbye ba dang / de'i man ngag skor/ bya ba'i rgyud la rgyud sde'i dum bu nyis brgya tsam yan lag dang bcas pa man ngag phra mos brgyan pa dang /spyod pa'i rgyud la gshin rje'i gshed khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud yan lag dang bcas pa dang / rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud lnga la slob dpon 'phags pa yab sras kyi dgongs pa 'brel ba dang bcas pa/ gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag po'i rgyud gsum dang / dpal dgyes pa rdo rje rgyud gsum dang / 'khor lo bde mchog rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud gsum/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i 'grel ba/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud 'grel/ sgrub thabs bsdus pa/ man ngag phra mo brjod kyis mi lang ba gsan cing khong du chud par mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas rong ngur smrig tu brang ti dar ma snying po'i drung du dgung lo bcu gsum par mngon pa tshar gcig gis thugs su chud par mdzad nas bshad pa yang gnang ba yin no/ /brang ti'i zur chos pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyung po pa las rgyal ba'i bstan bcos byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang / sdom rnam gnyis bcas gsan te khong du chud 2

par mdzad cing / de nas nyang stod du khyung rin chen grags pa dang /zur chos pa dpal dig pa dang / grom pa g.yu rtse 'jid phur/ dge bshes me lhang rtse ba sogs las tshad ma rnam nges dang / rigs pa thigs pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa bam po lnga pa dang / dbu ma rang rgyud shar gsum du grags pa'i gzhung rnams la gsan bsam mdzad cing / yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgyi chu pa las dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud rgyas pa gsum pa/ rgyud chung gsum gyi 'grel ba ku mu ta dang / de'i man ngag gi skor gyis mtshon rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi dbang lung man ngag dang bcas pa rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan/ gzhan yang rje btsun na ro ta pa'i thugs kyi sras dpal phan phing gu ba dang / bla ma pham ring ba dang / bal po paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma shri dang / bla ma pu hrang lo chung dang / rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor pa bho ta ru hu la dang / bal po paṇ+ḍi ta badz+ra/ bla ma rje dgon pa/ mdo khams kyi sa'i cha 'gri klung du sku 'khrungs pa'i bla ma skyur a skyabs sogs rgya bod bal gsum gyi mkhas grub du ma bsnyen nas/ slob dpon 'phags pa yab sras kyi dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs dang / bstod tshogs rnams kyi rtsa ba dang 'grel ba/ yan lag brgyad pa sogs sman dpyad kyi gzhung lugs du ma dang / bya spyod rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud sogs kyis mtshon man ngag lam skor dgu dang /man ngag skor phra mo nyer lnga dang / man ngag thams cad kyi yang snying 3

gtso bor rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bi ru pa'i gdams ngag bi rgyab brten rgyud rkyang nga/'i bshad pa shin tu zab nga/'i lugs dang bcas pa thugs su chud par mdzad nas/ mdo sngags gzhung lugs rab 'byams la thos bsam phyogs med du gnang ste thos pa'i pha rol tu son cing / bla ma gong ma de dag las rdo rje theg pa nos pa gang yin pa de dag gi rjes su bzlas pa'i lung dang / sems bskyed dang rig pa gtad pa'i cho ga dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang bskur ba dang /byin gyis brlab pa dang bcas pa/ sgrub pa'i lung dang / rjes su gnang ba'i lung dang / bshad pa'i lung dang bcas pa rnams brgyud pa so so'i cho ga ma 'dres shing gang gi yang yan lag ma tshang ba med pa'i cho ga thams chad nos shing thugs su chud par byas nas skal ba dang 'tsham pa'i 'gro ba rnams rjes su 'dzin par mdzad pa yin no//gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgo nas ting nge 'dzin dang rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mnga' dbang 'byor zhing rje btsun 'jam dpal las chos gsan pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar du ma bskyangs/ lhag par du zhang dgon pa ba las lo bzhi'i ring du chos dkar po gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa ma lus pa thugs su chud par mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu par bla ma ba ri bas khong la gdan sa gtad nas zhi bar gshegs/ dgung lo lnga bcu par gsang sngags kyi bka' rgya lo bco 4

brgyad yod pa grol nas gang zag so so'i mos blo ltar 'chad nyan gyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad cing / dad pa dang sgrub pa'i sgo nas bla ma rnams kyi thugs mnyes par mdzad de/ gdul bya du ma smin grol gyi lam la bkod de bstan 'gro'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad nas/ gsung gi bdud rtsi bzhes pa'i slob ma yang / slob dpon bsod nams rtse mos mtshon mchog gsum thob pa gsum/ bzod pa thob pa bdun/ rtogs ldan brgyad cu bcas grags che ba'i brgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma bgrang las 'das pa bskrun cing / rtsom pa legs bshad kyi phreng ba gsar du spel ba yang lam 'bras bsdus don ma/ dpal ldan bi ru pa la bstod pa dang / rdo rje gung gi thob yig slob dpon mtsho skyes kyi lo rgyus bcas gsung 'bum pod gnyis rjes 'jug gdul bya'i gsos su bzhag nas/ gdul bya'i skye bo phal cher dang mthun nga/ra snang ba'i pha rol tu phyin nga/ drug dang ldan zhing lam rim nga/ gnyis kyis mdzes par byas nas bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sems can gyi don 'ba' zhig bsgrubs te/ mthar dgung grangs drug cu rtsa bdun pa bod rab byung gsum pa'i sa pho stag gi lo ste spyi lo 1158lor g.yas ru skya bo kha gdangs su gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa yin no/ /4 5

slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/khong ni bod rab byung gnyis pa'i chu pho khyi yi lo ste spyi lo 1142lor dpal ldan sa skya ru yab sa chen kun dga' snying po dang / yum ma gcig 'od sgron gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te sku 'khrungs/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du mi thub zla ba sogs paṇ+ḍi ta bcu gcig brgyud nas skye ba bzhes te 'gro don mdzad pas yum la btsas ma thag tu sibla ta'i skad kyis bdag ni byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das pa'o zhes lan gnyis su brgyud nas gsungs shing dus kun tu skyil krung byas pas ya mtshan par gyur to//dgung lo gsum par rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ dpal kye rdo rje/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ rje btsun mi g.yo ba rnams kyi zhal gzigs shing /rgyud gsum/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ kun las btus pa dang lnga thugs thog nas gsungs/ de nas yab las rdo rje theg pas bsdus pa'i rgyud 'grel/ sgrub dkyil/ dbang / byin rlabs/ gdams ngag phyag bzhes/khrid bka' lung bka' bcas legs par gsan nas ma lus pa thugs su chud par mdzad de/ dgung lo bcu bdun par rgyud sde bcu bzhi thugs nas gsungs shing rdo rje theg pa mtha' dag la mkhas par rgya bod kun tu grags/ rdo rje gdan gyi ya them la 'jam dpal 6

gyi sprul pa mkhan po bsod nams rtse mo rdo rje thes pa mtha' dag gi dbang phyug dam pa sa skyar skyes zer ba'i mkha' 'gro ma'i yi ge bris pa kau sham+bhi'i paṇ+ḍi ta de wa ma tis phyogs kun tu grags pa bod nyid la rtsad chod zer/ de nas gdan sa gcung po grags pa rgyal mtshan la gtad nas dbus phyogs su byon/ gsang phu ne'u thog tu cha pa chos kyi seng ge las lo bcu gcig gi bar du tshad ma rig pa sogs slob gnyer mthar phyin mdzad cing / mkhas pa'i grags pa thob ste jo sras bzhi'i ya gyal 'khon jo sras rtse mo zhes yongs su grags/ dgung lo nyer drug par na la rtse'i gnas po che'i gtsug lag khang du chos la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mdzad cing / gzhan yang nyin mtshan kun tu yi dam gyi lha dang / rje btsun rnal gyi 'byor dbang phyug dpal bi ru pa la mngon sum du rgyun ma chad pa chos tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan cing the tshom bcad par mdzad pas shes bya rig pa'i gnas thams cad la bsnyel ba mi mnga' bar gyur/ dgung lo nyer bdun par 'dzam bu gling gi bstan pa'i srog shing chen po yin no zhes pa'i mtshan snyan thob/ dgung lo nyer brgyad par gzims khang rnying par lam 'bras gsungs pas lta ba'i khrid kyi skabs su tshes gcig gi nyin slob ma rnams kyi snang ngo la mi yi 'du shes nub nas 'jam dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs kyi sku dngos su mjal zhing / mdor na dam pa 'di nyid kyi sku tshe hril por 7

g.yel ba med par 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor 'ba' zhig la gzhol zhing / rjes thob sgyu ma lta bur mkhyen nas sbyin pa rnam bzhis sems can rnams tshim par mdzad cing / po ta la dang zangs mdog dpal ri/ u rgyan gyi yul sogs su rdzu 'phrul gyis byon te dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams dang tshogs kyi spyod pa'i brtul zhugs la rol te nyin phyed tsam gyis phyir phebs pa sogs rdzu 'phrul du ma la mnga' dbang 'byor/ dam pa 'di nyid kyi zhal gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma grags che ba ni/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / gtsug tor dpon po/ rmog ston nam mkha' rje ba/ jo lcags sogs slob tshogs nam mkha'i skar tshogs dang mnyam par gyur/ rtsom pa'i legs bshad kyi phreng ba gsar du mdzad pa la yang sa skya ba chen po la bstod pa dang / lam 'bras brgyud nga/'i gsol 'debs 'brel mar yod pa/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag brtag gnyis kyi rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer/ sasto ṭa'i 'grel pa sand kyi gsal byed/ dang/la kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa/ bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa la sogs sngon med kyi legs bshad pod gsum rjes 'jug gdul bya'i gsos su bzhag cing / gdan sa lo gsum mdzad nas gcung la gdan sa'i mthil gzhug gtad de phal cher dben pa la gzhol ba mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs zhe gcig pa bod rab byung gsum pa'i chu pho stag gi lo 8

ste spyi lo 1182lor rgya sar ma ga dh+war gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus nga/ yin no/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/khong gi bod rab byung gsum pa'i me mo yos kyi lo ste spyi lo 1147lor dpal ldan sa skyar yab sa chen kun dga' snying po dang / yum ma gcig sgron gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te sku 'khrungs/ cung zad mno shes pa nas dben pa la dgyes shing brkam chags med pa yon tan gyi cha kho na sgrub pa la brtson zhing byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das pa zhig tu gyur to/ /de nas dgung lo brgyad lon pa dang byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i sdom brtson chen po de las tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen nos te/ bslab par bya ba'i phyogs phra ba'i phra ba la yang byis pa nyid nas spyan gyi 'bras bu bzhin 'tsho ba zhig bo/ dgung lo bcu par byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nyi shu pa la sogs pa du ma dang bcas pa mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu gcig par rang gi slob dpon rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis zhus ngor gzhung don thugs las gsungs pas/ tshogs pa thams cad ngo mtshar skyes nas blo gros chen po zhes bya bar mtshan gsol/ dgung lo bcu gnyis par tho rangs kyi cha la bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje rgyud gsum 9

gyi pu ti gsol ba'i mnal lam byung ba dang / de nyid kyi tshe chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid khong du chud par gyur/ de'i tshe rtsa rgyud brtag nga/ gnyis pa gsung bar bzhed pa na bla ma sa skya ba chen po sku gshegs/ de'i mdad la phyogs med kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams spyan drangs nas dus gsum khegs so zhes pa'i chos 'khor dang sbyin gtong rgya chen po mdzad pa'i dus su rang gi slob dpon du gyur pa gnyan dang zhang la sogs pa dag gis gtso byas pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis zhu ba phul ba'i ngor brtag pa gnyis pa thugs nas gsungs pas thams cad ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gyur/dgung lo bcu gsum par gcen rin po che bsod nams rtse mos sa skya'i gdan sar bkod cing / gsang sngags kyi gzhung gi bshad pa du ma mdzad/ gdams ngag bla ma'i bka' rgya lo dgu mdzad pa la lo bcu gsum gyi bar du ma gsungs zhes gsung ngo / /gzhung 'chad pa'i bar skabs rnams su rang gi slob dpon gzhan dang gzhan rnams las gzhung lugs tha dad pa du ma gsan te/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa la dgyes pa rdo rje rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud mtha' dag dang / 'grel ba sgrub thabs yan lag dang bcas pa'i bzhed srol mi 'dra ba du ma dang bcas pa dang / bde mchog 'khor lo rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud yan lag dang bcas pa dang / zhal gyi lung yan lag dang bcas pa'i man ngag dpal dus kyi 'khor lo phyi nang gi 10

rtsis man ngag dang bcas pa/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud 'phags pa de kho na nyid bsdus pa 'grel pa de kho na nyid snang ba dang bcas pa'i rgyud yan lag dang bcas pa dang / bya ba'i rgyud gsang ba spyi rgyud dang bcas pa thugs su chud do/ /gzhan yang slob dpon gzhan dang gzhan rnams las pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung gi mdo dang bstan bcos kyi cha du ma dang / gsang sngags kyi gzhung phran tshegs rnams dang / man ngag gi bye brag dpag tu med pa gsan te thos pa'i pha rol tu son te/ sgrub pa gnyis la thugs gzhol ba'i rim pa gnyis la brtan pa chen po thob pa'i nges pa'i shes pa skye zhing / yi dam gyi lhas byin gyis brlabs pa dang / bsams na shes pa'i mngon par shes pa la sogs pa dang / nang du yang dag par 'jog pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab cing / chos 'chad skabs gzhan gyis brtsad cing dris pa na chos dang mthun pa'i lan 'debs pa ni spobs pa thogs pa mi mnga' bar lung dang rigs pas pha rol gyi log rtog sel ba la rtog ge pa chen po sgra yi cha la ma rmongs pa dag gis kyang ba spu ldang ba zhig go/ grub pa'i mtshan ma mngon du brnyes pa kha che paṇa chen gyis nyi ma gza' 'dzin yod par dus btab par khong gis gza' 'dzin med par bsgyur bar mdzad pas/ kha che paṇa chen gyis dam pa 'di nyid gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du gzigs te ma hā badz+ra dngos su 'dug ces bsngags brjod mdzad/11

dbu rtse rnying ma'i gtsug lag khang dang / rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo sde dang rgyud sde 'gyur ro cog phal cher rgyu rin po che dang po dang gnyis pa las bskrun par mdzad cing / chos bzhin sgrub pa'i dge 'dun brgya rtsa brgyad kyi zhabs 'bring mdzad nas yo byad phal cher bsgrubs pa ma zad/ dkon mchog gsum gyi nye bar mkho ba'i mchod pa'i bkod pa dang / mar me phreng ba dang / chen po la 'os pa gdugs dang rol mo'i cha byad du ma dang / bla bre dang / lhab lhub kyi bkod pa mtha' dag bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa mi nyams shing 'phel bar bya ba'i don kho na mdzad do/ /dbul phongs la sbyin pa gtong ba sogs chos phyogs kyi bya ba kho nar gtong bar mdzad pas/ sku gshegs skabs gdan dang na bza' cha tshang gcig ma gtogs dngos po gang yang ma lus par mdzad cing / 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i slob tshogs nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar bskrun pa ra ma zad/ legs par bshad pa'i cha gsung rab gsar du mdzad pa yang lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rgyud gsum rin po che'i ljon shing / rgyud sde dum bu brgya bcu gsum pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po'i rnam thar/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i 'grel ba/ 'jam dbyangs chen mo sogs pod bzhi rjes 'jug gdul bya'i gsos su bzhag nas/ bshad sgrub 'khor lo gnyis ldan gyi sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa 12

rin po che bla lhag tu spel te mthar dgung grangs bdun cu pa bod rab byung bzhi pa'i me pho byi ba'i lo ste spyi lo 1216lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su gshegs pa yin no/ /sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/khong ni bod rab byung gsum pa'i chu pho stag gi lo ste spyi lo 1182lor dpal ldan sa skya ru yab 'khon dpal chen 'od po che dang / yum ma cig gar phu ma nyi khri lcam zhes bya ba gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan du ma dang bcas te sku 'khrungs shing mtshan dpal ldan don grub tu gsol/ de nas skyed bsrings te gog thal thub pa'i dus su skye ba snga ma'i bag chags sad pa'i stobs kyis seskreta'i skad smra ba dang / yi ge'i bye brag rgya bod yig la sogs pa dang / rtsis dang / gso dpyad dang / ri mo la sogs pa bye brag thams cad kyang bslab pa tsam gyis tshegs med du mkhyen cing /gzhon nu nas yon tan gyi gter chen por gyur pas mkhas pa gzhan du ma dang / nyid kyi slob dpon du gyur pa de dag kyang sprul pa dang byin gyis brlabs pa yin gyi rang rgyud pa ma yin no zhes gsung zhing kun gyis ngo mtshar du 'dzin to/ /khu bo grags pa rgyal mtshan las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes te mtshan kun dga' rgyal mtshan gsol/ gzhan yang gzhon nu nyid nas rang gi yab las 1 3

dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs mtsho skyes dang / yan lag drug pa dang /dbang chu/ rab gnas/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'khor lo bde mchog lo hi pa/ rdo rje dril bu'i skor gsum/ mi g.yo ba/ rdo rje rnam 'joms ma la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs thugs dam du mdzad pa rnams dang / bla ma lnga bcu pa/ sdom pa nyi shu pa/ phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs brtag pa'i skor dang bcas pa/ sman dpyad kyi gzhung man ngag rnams gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /dgung lo brgyad par mtsho skyes la bshad pa mdzad/ bcu gnyis pa la rgyud brtag gnyis la bshad pa mdzad/ bcu bzhi pa la sastota gsungs/ bco lnga par yab mes kyi chos ma lus pa thugs su chud par mdzad cing / thog mar bshes gnyen dam pa ji snyed cig bsnyen cing gang las dri ma med pa'i rgyud dang mdo sne dang bstan bcos ma lus pa gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad pa dang / sgro 'dogs pa dang / skur ba'i mtha' gnyis po rnam par bsal te/ ji ltar gnas pa'i don mdo tsam zhig rtogs pa gang yin de 'dir brjod pa ni 'di lta ste/ de yang sdom brtson dam pa 'dis chos kyi rje khams gsum gyi rnam par 'dren pa thun mong ma yin par gyur pa rje btsun rin po che rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs dang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgyu chu ba sogs rdo rje slob dpon du ma bsnyen nas/ dri ma med pa'i rgyud sde chen po rnams rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud dang bcas pa/ de dag so so'i dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa'i 14

rnam 'grel du ma dang / rgyud sde so so'i dbongs pa dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang / de'i lha mnyes par byed pa so so'i sgrub pa'i thabs ma lus pa dang / zab mor gyur pa'i rgyud sde ma lus pa'i gces pa'i gnad/ dpal ldan chos skyong rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bi ru pa la sogs pa dngos grub brnyes pa mtha' dag gi dgongs pa/skye ba 'di nyid la 'tshang rgya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi gnad khyad par can man ngag rin po che thams cad kyi mdzod 'dzin pa/ bla ma dam pa gu gu lung pa'i thugs kyi sras bla ma se mkhar chung ba zhes bya ba'i zhabs rdul dri ma med pa las mnos shing / rje btsun zhang dgon pa zhes bya bas dpal sa skya pa brtse ba chen po la rjes su gdams pa/lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa/ gzhan lam gyi skor dgu zhes grags pa la man ngag phra mo nyi shu rtsa lnga la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab cing de re re la'ang yan lag du ma dang bcas pa dang / khyad par dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa lag len dang bcas pa dang / byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa ngo sprod dang bcas pa dang / gdams ngag gi sarga ma log pa lung sbyin dang bcas pa dang / mos gus gyi bsam pa tshim pa drod tshad dang bcas pa zhus shing nos la mngon du mdzad de rgyud sde rin po che mtha' dag gi mdzod 'dzin pa chen por gyur pa yin no/ /gzhan yang rig pa smra ba chen po rkyang 'dur ba gzhon nu seng ge cha dbang phyug seng ge bram ze'i slob dpon brda sprod pa chen po su ga 15

ta shri dang / paṇ+ḍi ta chen po megha shri/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shri/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta bha rarnyi/ rtog ge ba chen po da na shi la/ chos rje bsod snyoms pa chen po sogs rgya bod kyi mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs te/ sgra dang tshad ma rnams dang / pha rol tu phyin pa dang 'dul ba dang / rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs gang zhig gsan pa de dag thams cad la legs par bsams shing gtugs te som nyi med par ma lus pa rtogs shing khong du chud par mdzad de rig pa'i gnas bcu la sbyangs pa mthar phyin mdzad de paṇ+ḍi ta'i mtshan snyan thob/ dgung lo nyer bdun par paṇa chen shākya shris mkhan po mdzad cing / spyi bo lhas slob dpon mdzad/ don mo ri bas gsang ste ston pa mdzad de dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad de ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa kun gyi tog ltar gyur/ de ltar dam pa 'di nyid kyi mdzad pa 'phrin las kyang 'chad pa'i tshe rnam bshad rigs nga/ las byung ba ltar dgos bsdus tshig don mtshams sbyar brgal lan gyi sgo nas gzhung mtha' dag legs par gtan la phab cing / dris pa'i spobs pa thogs pa med pa skabs su bab pa'i lan chos dang mthun par 'debs la/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la gang 'chad kyang mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog par mdzad pa dang / mi ma yin pa dag gi the tshom gyi dra ba gcod par mdzad cing / rtsom pa'i phreng 16

ba mchog tu gyur pa mdzad pa rnams ni brjod bde zhing rna bar snyan la yid du 'ong bas gser gyi rgyan la rin po che pad+ma rā ga dang in+d+ra ni la la sogs pas spras pa/ mu tig gi phreng bas bskor zhing blta na sdug pa bas kyang mchog tu mdzes pa'i rtsom pa'i phreng ba rnams ni mthong zhing thos na mkhas pa rnams kyi yid dga' ba skye zhing / blo gsal rnams kyi kha rgyan du gyur la shes ldan rnams yid smon gyi gnas su byed pa sha stag mdzad pa yin no/ /rtsod pa'i tshul ni mtshungs pa med pa'i blo gros dang ldan zhing 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa myur du 'joms pa yin te/ rang gi sde pa la bod kyi blo gsal mkhas pa chen por rlom zhing / smra ba po grags pa du ma yang pham par mdzad cing rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta 'ga' zhig kyang zil gyis mnan la/ gzhan gyi sde ba mu stegs 'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs pa phyi rol pa'i mkhas pa drug kyang spobs pa med par byas nas lta bar btsud cing / de ltar dgung lo drug cu re gsum gyi bar du bod gangs can gyi ljongs su bzhugs nas/ rim gnyis zab mo'i thugs dam la rtag tu mnyam gzhag gi ngang nas chos 'chad pa dang / rtsod pa dang / rtsom pas dus 'da' bar byed cing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba lta bu mdzad pa'i dbang gis 'dzam bu gling thams cad du mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab pas/ rgyal po go dan gyis chos rje'i sku'i snyan pa'i grags pa gsan par brten/17

dgung lo re gsum pa shing pho 'brug gi lor sku tsha 'gro mgon 'phags pa dang / phyag na rdo rje sku mched gnyis dang bcas dpal ldan sa skya nas btegs te lam son yod pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang / skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya mang por dbang byin rlabs dang / rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa la sogs pa dad pa chen po'i sgo nas zhu ba rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing byon pa'i dbang gis lam bar du lo gsum 'gor bas/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa lnga pa me pho rta'i lor ling cur gdan phebs te/ hor go tan rgyal po smin grol gyi lam la bkod de/ skad rigs mi gcig pa'i gdul bya chos la dad par byas/ dad pa rnams theg pa chen po la btsud cing gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin cing grol bar mdzad pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che sgo kun nas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad nas/ mthar dgung grangs bdun cu pa bod rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags mo phag gi lo ste spyi lo 1251lor lang cur gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdu ba'i tshul bstan pa yin no/ /'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/khong ni bod rab byung bzhi pa'i shing mo lug gi lo ste spyi lo 1235lor dpal ldan sa skyar yab zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / yum ma gcig kun dga' skyid gnyis kyi sras su ngo 18

mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te sku 'khrungs/ rgya gar dang bod la sogs pa'i yi ge mi 'dra ba du ma dang / rtsis dang / bzo'i gnas dang / legs par sbyar ba'i skad dang / sgra dang tshad ma'i bstan bcos dang / sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos dang / rgyan dang / mngon brjod gso ba rig pa la sogs pa dang / zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul du ma dag kyang ma bslabs par rang gis mngon par shes pas mngon sum du mdzad pa yin te/ gzhon nu des legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyis paṇ+ḍi ta rnams dang 'bel gtam gsungs shing / rgya gar gyi yi ge du ma la shin tu myur bar 'bri ba sogs 'ga' zhig gis mthong bas shin tu ngo mtshar du gyur te/ bdag nyid chen po 'di ni gzhon nu nyid nas mkhyen rab phun sum tshogs shing chos kyi mnga' bdag chen por gyur pa yin la/ dgung lo gsum par kye rdo rjes sgrub thabs mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa la sogs nga dang /gzhan yang gsang sngags kyi chos zab mo du ma gsungs pas 'gro ba mang po'i rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzad pas/ 'di ni nges par 'phags pa'o zhes phyogs thams cad du sgrogs par gyur to/ /de nas dgung lo bdun gyi bar mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta nyid la mnga' ba'i dbang dang / byin rlabs kyi bka' du ma dang / man ngag dang / zab pa dang / rgya che ba'i chos kyi sgo du ma gsan cing khong du chud par mdzad cing / gzhan la yang rgya cher 19

ston par mdzad/ dgung lo brgyad par rab tu byung ba khri phrag dang /sde snod 'dzin pa stong phrag du ma dang / chos smra ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gdugs 'dzin pa stong du tshogs pa rnams la bdas nyid chen po 'di nyid kyis kyang kye rdo rje rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa dang / skyes rabs so bzhi pa sogs zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi phung po du ma rnam par phye zhing bstan pas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad shin tu ngo mtshar du gyur/ dgung lo dgu pa la nye bar gyur pa na/ mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs kun tu g.yo bas sa chen po'i steng na gnas pa'i mi'i dbang po phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyang legs par bshad pa'i bsil zer du ma 'byin pa'i zhal gyi zla ba blta bar 'dod par gyur te/ chen po hor gyi rgyal po'i gdung rgyud rgyal srid yangs pa la mnga' dbang sgyur ba'i rgyal bu go dan gyis gdan drangs te/ bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa sku mched dang bcas pa shar phyogs kyi sa cha khag rnams su byon tshe gtsang gi sa cha gnas pa'i skye bo thams cad kyis chos zhus shing phyi bzhin 'brangs bar gyur te dbus su byon nas skye bo phal mo che theg pa gsum la bcug cing / bla na med pa'i byang chub tu nges par mdzad nas/ de'i dus su bdag nyid chen po 'dis mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta la mkhan po dang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen zul phu ba la slob dpon zhus shing / de'i 20

bslab bya rnams dge ba'i bshes gnyen skyor mo lung pa las legs par gsan cing rab tu byung nas mtshan blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes gsol nas ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzes par byas/ de nas rim gyis mdo khams dang / mdo smad dang / byang ngos kyi sa char byon te/ de dag rnams su yang theg pa gsum gyi chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor zhing gdul bya dpag tu med pa grol bar mdzad do/ /dgung lo bcu bdun par chos kyi rje nyid la mnga' ba'i yon tan gyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur te/ 'gro ba phal mo che yang 'di nyid kyis 'dul bar chos rjes gzigs nas chos kyi dung dang lhung bzed la sogs pa bdag nyid chen po 'di la gtad nas/ da ni khyed kyi bstan pa'i bya ba dang sems can dpag tu med pa'i don bya ba ba'i dus la babs pas sngon gyi dam bca' ba dran par gyis shig ces gsungs nas slob ma'i tshogs dang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che gtad de ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma bstan nas bde bar gshegs par gyur to/ /chos kyi rje zhi bar gshegs pa'i rjes kyi bya ba chen po rnams rim pa bzhin bsgrubs/ slob ma'i tshogs dang skye dgu phal mo che ni theg pa gsum gyi chos kyi dga' ston gyis yang dag par mgu bar byas nas rim gyis sa'i bdag por go be la'i pho brang du byon te/ theg pa gsum gyi chos kyi gtam gyis dad par byas nas/ slar yang mi'i bdag po go be la'i sras 21

dang / btsun mo dang / blon po tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis spyi bor zhabs kyi pad+mo la gtugs shing / shin tu zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi sgo du ma zhus te bdag nyid chen po la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob nas/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag gcig pur gyur to/ /rgyal po chen po de'i mnga' 'og na gnas pa'i skad rigs mi gcig pa du ma la bdag nyid chen po 'dis theg pa gsum gyi chos kyi char chen po phab nas skad rigs mi gcig pa bcu bzhi la dbang bskur bar mdzad cing / bla na med pa'i byang chub tu nges par mdzad/ khyad par du mi'i dbang po go be la'i gsung gis rgya nag la sogs pa rnams la rang rang gi yi ge yod pa bzhin du nged hor rnams la yang nged rang gi skad kyis bklags pas chog pa'i yi ge mdzad par zhu zhes bskul nas sngon chad hor rnams la yi ge med pa la/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis yi ge khyad par du 'phags pa mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par dbye ba rgya cher mdzad pa'i tshe rgya'i yul du sngon byung ba tha'i shang lam shin zhes bya ba'i rjes su 'brangs ba zin shing gi ston pa'i gzhung lugs bcu bdun po yang dag pa'i rigs pas pham par mdzad nas lta ba ngan pa bzlog ste/ yang dag pa'i lta ba 'dzin du bcug nas rab tu byung ste thub pa'i bstan pa che cher gsal bar mdzad do/ /de ltar shar phyogs kyi rgyal khab chen po rnams su rgyal ba'i 22

bstan pa dar bar mdzad cing / 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad nas slar yang kha ba can pa rnams la thugs rjes gzigs shing / gdan sa chen po nas gsol ba 'debs pa rnams su byon nas gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzad/de'i tshe bdag nyid chen po'i phyag tu longs spyod kyi dngos po bzang zhing rgya che ba byung ba rnams 'di phyi don dang ldan par mdzad de bdag nyid chen po 'dis chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa rdzogs ldan gyi dus kyi sprin chen po lta bu phab pas/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi 'gro ba thams cad kyi skyabs gnas dam par gyur ba yin no/ /de nas kha che paṇ+ḍi ta shri ga ta bha tra dang / glo lo tsā shes rab rin chen/ snar thang mkhan chen mchims nam mkha' grags/ zhang zhung ba rdo rje 'od zer/rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rga lo/ slob dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyi ma dpal/ bshes gnyen nyi ma 'od zer sogs mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag gnyis lhag bsnyen te/ dam chos zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chu klung grangs med pa thams cad chos kyi rgya mtsho chen por ro gcig tu gyur te/ thos pa'i mdzod 'dzin chen po bzung nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtsa lag gcig pur gyur pa yin no/ /de nas gong ma'i bka' ltar slar rgya nag tu phebs/dgung lo nyer gcig pa shing yos lo ste spyi lo 1255lor snye thang mkhan chen grags pa seng ge las dge slong gi sdom pa yang dag par 23

bzhes shing / slar yang kha ba can pa rnams la thugs rje gzigs shing gtsang du phebs te/ gdul bya du ma la chos kyi 'khor lo bar med du bskor bar mdzad cing / me mo glang gi lor sa bdag chen po go be la'i sras kyi thu bo rgyal tshab dam pa byang chub sems dpa' jim gyis yon bdag mdzad de/ gtsang gi chu mig ring mor chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba'i tshe ngur smrig 'dzin pa khri phrag bdun dang / sde snod 'dzin pa stong phrag du ma/ skye bo phal ba 'bum du longs pa la chos dang zing zing gi bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas blo yul las 'das par mdzad/ rim gyis gdan sar byon nas rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo sde la sogs pa bod du 'gyur ba rnams la dus phyis yi ge dang brda/ tha snyad go rim log par gyur pa rnams legs par bcos te shin tu dag par byas nas go rim la sogs legs par bsgrigs shing / dbus gtsang gi yig mkhan mkhas pa du ma bsags nas rgya yul nas byung ba'i shing sngon gya rnam pa la rgyu rin po che gser gyis bzhengs shing / de dag so so la yang gser gyi glegs shing dang / nyi 'og gi gos chen gya rnam pa'i na bza' la sogs pas spras par mdzad de/ bka' bsdu ba gsum pa lta bur mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar skyes bu dam pa 'dis sngon gyi slob dpon klu sgrub la sogs pa dang mthun par bstan bcos dang / springs yig gdams pa sogs pod gsum rjes 'jug gdul bya'i gsos su bzhag nas/24
ga pa bod 80lor lha bsdus pa rkyo

dang po/ dpal ldan glang nag dgon pa'i byung ba bsdus tsam brjod pa puṇ+ḍa ri ba'i do shal/dpal ldan glang nag dbon pa'am dpal bsam 'grub mthong grol gling zhes pa'i sa dgon 'di thog mar ji ltar byung tshul ni khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che khong / rgya nag tu thengs gsum par phebs pa'i yar lam ste bod rab byung lnga pa'i me pho byi ba spyi lo 1276lor phyag btab gnang zhes zer srol 'dug mod/ 'on kyang dgon 'di'i lo rgyus rgyas pa ru khong gi sku 'khor du maḥdam pa bde gshegs dang / grub dbang thang rgyal sogs byon tshul ni lo rgyus dngos dang mi mthun pa'i ngag rgyun ma dag pa re 'ga' yang byung 'dug pas nges par dag bcos zhu'o/ /de nas rgyal dbang lnga ba'i dus su sog dmag gis bka' brgyud dang sa skya sogs kyi dgon pa mang po brlags bcom btang ba'i dus/ tre stod kyi ri phug sa dgon dang / 'bur logs sa dgon/glang nag sa dgon sogs la yang nyams nyen chen po byung tshul dang /de rjes nyag gi mgon po rnam rgyal gyis rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i 26

lcags pho sprel te spyi lo 1860lor yang gtor brlags tshabs chen btang / de rjes sa skya gong ma phyogs kyi glang po khong dgon 'dir phyag phebs gnang ste zhal bsgos bzhin 'bur logs dgon dang /ri phug dgon pa'i grwa rtsa sa rgya dang bcas pa dgon 'dir bsdus/ /de rjes rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing glang ste spyi lo 1925lo yas mas cha phreng gi jag dmag skya mi drug brgya lhag rta khog nas 'gyur te lung khog der rong pa tsha ba'i mi nga gnyis tsam bsad cing yul dgon spyi la gnod tshabs chen po bzos/ de nas rig gsar skabs te spyi 1966lor dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa bcas la nyams nyen tshabs chen thebs pa bcas so/ /gdan rabs dang po/dge 'phel mchog sprul sku phreng dang po mkhyen rab dge 'phel rin po che ni khyim bdag gling la sgang tshang la 'khrungs/ dgung grangs bco brgyad thog dpal sa skyar phebs te bco brgyad khri ba dga' chen khyab bdag snying po sogs dam pa du ma las dpal sa skya'i gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i dbang khrid lung man ngag mtha' dag zab rgyas mnos te/ rang yul bstan 'gro'i mgon du phyag phebs 'byor nas dge 'phel ri khrod gsar du btab pas gnas dang gang zag gnyis kur dge 'phel zhes 27

pa'i mtshan thogs/ de nas dpal kyai rdo rje sogs lhag lha mang po'i bsnyen sgrub kho na gtso bo mdzad de/ mthar dgung grangs don bdun par gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus so/ /ljags rtsom yang grub mtha'i rnam gzhag dang / 'dul ba'i sdom tshig lam 'bras zin bris/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i dka' 'grel bcas bzhugs so/ /gdan rabs gnyis pa/dge 'phel mchog sprul sku phreng gnyis pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan rin po che ni snyi khog tu sku 'khrungs/ 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin du ma'i gong ma'i skye sprul 'khrul med du ngos bzung gnang / snga gzhug rnams su mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa yongs 'dzin dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs dam pa mang po bsten te gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa sdom pa gsum gyi chos kyi bdud rtsi mtha' yas pa bzhes/ dpal kyai rdo rje sogs lhag lha mang po'i bsnyen pa lan grangs dang / 'khor lo gsum gyi bya bas bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che yang bsgrubs/ dgung grangs so gsum thog dag zhing du gshegs so/ /gdan rabs gsum pa/dge 'phel mchog sprul sku phreng gsum pa snyan grags bstan 28

pa'i dbang phyug rin po che ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing pho stag ste spyi lo 1854lor rdo ring khug tu yab skal bzang dang yum bsod nams mtsho gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dpal sa skya pa 'jam mgon rdo rje rin po che bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa du mas dge 'phel skye phreng gsum pa ngos bzung gnang / dgung lo phyed gsum thog yi ge 'bri klog bslab pas tshegs med du mkhyen/ de nas snga gzhug rnams su chos rje dpal sprul/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po sogs skyes chen dam pa bcu phrag 'ga' zhig bsten nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa/ra mdzad/ khyad par dpal sa skya'i 'jam mgon mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog dang /dpal sa skya pa byams pa phyogs kyi glang po rnam gnyis rigs kyi bdag por gyur te sor byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa dang / gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras sogs la gsan bsam sgom pa'i nyams bzhes dpyis phyin par gnang ngo / /rab byung de'i me stag ste spyi lo 1866lor hor stod smad yongs la sa yom gyis gnod pas mi phyugs phal cher lnga lam du btang ba ma zad/ chos rje phyogs kyi glang po yang des rkyen gyis glang nag dgon du sku gshegs so/ /29

dam pa 'di pa'i rnam thar mdo bsdus lag 'byor byung ba las/thog mar sa skya gong ma phyogs kyi glang po khong rab byung gi sdom pa 'bogs pa khams su phebs te lo mang tsam bzhugs/ rjes su tre hor glang nag dgon du zhabs sor 'khod/ de dus ngor shar chen klu lding 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho rin po che khong yid lhung lha rgyal dgon der bzhugs yod pas/ nyin zhig gong ma phyogs kyi glang pos tre hor glang nag dbon nas bang chen btang thog phyag bris su gsal bar/ nga rang tshe'i 'du byed yun ring gnas pa'i nges pa med cing / mkhan chen khyed kyis gsang yum mtshan ldan zhig bzhes na de'i sras su nga rang byon rgyu'i bsam blo yod la de lugs dgongs par mnga' ba zhu dgos gsungs/ klu lding mkhan rin po che nas phyi nyin zhabs grwa bang mi zhu rten gyi dngul rdo tshad gcig gzig lpags spus ldan bcas ched gtong mdzad cing / zhu rgyu'i nang gsal bstan 'gro'i mgon du gong ma rin po che zhing 'dir zhabs pad bskal brgyar 'tsho zhing bzhugs thub par gsol ba snying nas 'debs pa dang / gus pa'ang bgrang bya smin shas che ba dang / rten rab byung /bang grwa shar bskyod kyis sde dge dang tre hor bar 'dam rgyang lhas nag la zer ba ru slebs skabs/ sa g.yos chen po zhig brgyab kyang bang mi la skyon ma byung ba phyin pas glang nag dgon du 'byor dus/gong ma rin po che khang pa rdib 'og zhing gzhan du gshegs zin pas 30

zhu 'phrin rten bcas 'bul yul bral te phyir mkhan chen mdun 'byor/ mkhan chen thugs skyo ba'i ngang nas gong ma rin po che'i bka' zlog ma nus pas/ mkhan gyis sde dge chos rgyal la blon chen gnyer mdun so brgyad yod pa'i nang tshan ho cho tshang zhes pa rigs dang rus mtho ba'i bu mo rin chen mtsho zhu ba de phyag brgya ma ru bzhes te bod rab byung bco lnga'i chu pho sprel te spyi lo 1872lor klu lding rgyal sras mkhan rabs re lnga pa 'jam dbyangs chos kyi nyi ma khong 'khrungs tshul sogs gsungs so/ /dge 'phel mchog sprul gsum pa 'di'i gsung skyes kyi slob ma yang bdag chen shar pa klu sding pa'i rgyal sras rin po che gtsos mkhas dang grub pa'i sa la bzhugs pa'i skyes chen dam pa mang po dang / mdo dbus khams gsum la slob tshogs bgrang gis mi langs pa bskyangs/ gzhan yang rten gsum gsar bzhengs dang sgrub mchod sna tshogs btsugs gnang mdzad cing dgung lo zhe bzhir phebs pa/ na rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa khyi spyi lo 1898lor yid lhung lha mtsho khar sku gshegs so/ /gdan rabs bzhi pa/dge 'phel mchog sprul sku phreng bzhi ba 'jam dbyangs kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma rin po che khong ni/ bod rab byung bco lnga pa'i 31

lcags pho byi ba ste spyi lo 1900lor lwa dkar grong du yab kun dga' dang / yum rin chen mkha' 'gro gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas sku bltams/ dpal sa skya'i khri chen rin ngo che drag shul phrin las rin chen mchog gtsos dam pa du mas dge 'phel skye phreng bzhi par ngos bzung gnang / rim bzhin yi ge 'bri klog sogs legs grub mdzad cing / mtshan ldan bla ma brag dkar mchog sprul blo bzang dpal ldan rin po che la tshul bzhin bsten te gzhung bka' pod lngar gsan bsam yang dag gnang bas nges pa don gyi mkhas pa chen por gyur/ snga gzhug rnams su dpal sa skya'i zhabs drung dam pa la ngag dbang blo gros snying po gtsos mkhas shing grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa'i dam pa du ma las sdom pa gsum dang / gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras sogs man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan bzhes legs par gnang / a mdo dhiḥphur dgon sogs la phebs te gdul bya'i slob ma dpag tu med pa smin grol la bkod/ bar skabs shig tu hor a thub dpon po dang go min tang sogs kyis rkyen 'ga' slong ste rang dgon du bzhugs blo med par gyur te rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa pho byi ba ste spyi lo 1948lor dgung grangs zhe dgu'i thog lha ldan du sku gshegs so/ /dam pa 'di pa la ljags rtsom yang dbyangs can sgra mdo'i 'grel ba dang / snyan ngag le'u bar pa'i 'grel ba/ bod ljongs sman rtsis khang 32

du bzhugs pa'i gso ba rig pa'i skor/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon po'i bla sgrub/ mkha' spyod kyi khrid yis chos rje sa paṇa dang gling rje ge sar la che ba brjod pa'i kun 'khor sogs bzhugs so/ /gdan rabs lnga pa/ dge 'phel mchog sprul sku phreng lnga pa kun dga' 'jam dbyangs snyan grags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rin po che khong ni/ bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu pho 'brug ste spyi lo 1952lor dpal spungs su yab yon tan dpal bzang dang / yum bkra shis mtsho gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang po dang 'brel sku 'khrungs/ dpal sa skya'i phun tshogs pho brang gi gong ma ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin po ches dge 'phel mchog sprul skye phreng lnga par lung du bstan/ de nas rdzong gsar 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse chos kyi blo gros rin po che dang / bla ma rin po che ngag dbang bzang po/ a rig mkhan chen pad+ma tshe dbang lhun grub rin po che sogs mtshan ldan bla ma bcu phrag lhag las zab rgyas chos kyi gdams pa mtha' yas pa gsan bsam nyams bzhes legs par gnang bar sogs dam pa'i rnam thar shin tu mang / rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa 'brug lor dgung grangs so bdun thog dge 'phel ri khrod du bde bar gshegs so/ /33

gdan rabs drug pa/dge 'phel mchog sprul sku phreng drug pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' snyan grags rin po che khong ni/ bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa mo sbrul te spyi lo 1989lor dge rtse zla tha ma'i ru khag gnyis par yab 'od zer nyi ma dang / yum lha skyid gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ de nas dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i skyes chen dam pa du ma'i dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig gis mchog sprul lnga pa'i yang srid 'khrul med du ngos 'dzin gnang / da skabs thos bsam sgom pa'i nyams bzhes lhur len bzhin bstan 'gro'i mgon du 'tsho zhing bzhes pa 'di sa lags so/ /

gnyis pa/ dpal ldan sa skya nas bla bskos rim pa phebs tshul gser ri'i phreng ba/de yang gna' dus nas dar srol byung ba'i dgon 'dir dpal sa skya nas bskos bla rim par phebs tshul yod mod/ phyis su byung ba zhig la bla ma kun dga' rin chen mchog dang / bla ma shākya/bla ma sbyin pa chos 'phel dang rnam pa gsum mo/ /

gsum pa/ dgon pa'i dus mchod kun gsal me long /dbon pa'i dus mchod skor la/ bod zla dang po'i tshes dgu nas tshe chog dngos sta gnyis nyin lnga/ tshes bcu bzhi nas kun rig sgrub mchod dngos sta gnyis nyin bcu dang / las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bcas so/ /tshes nyer lnga nas mkha' spyod ma nyin lnga sogs yod/ bod zla gnyis pa'i yar tshes nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin ngo/ che dbu nas mjug bar dag 'don dang / sgrol ma 'bum ther/ gur zhal lcam gsu ma sogs yod/ bod zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gcig nas mi 'khrugs dngos sta gnyis nyin lnga/ bod zla bzhi pa'i tshes bdun nas kyai rdor sgrub mchod dngos sta gnyis nyin brgyad/ tshes bco lnga nyin bstan pa rgyas chog nyin brgyad/ smyung gnas nyin gnyis/ bod zla lnga pa/'i tshes bco lnga nas bdun pa'i tshes 'bo bar dbyar gnas/ bod zla dgu ba'i nang na sa skor zhes pa'i kyai rdor sgrub mchod nyin lnga/bod zla bcu pa'i tshes lnga nas rdor sems nyin brgyad/ bod zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bzhi nas sa paṇa dus chen nyin gnyis/ bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer gnyis nas nyer dgu'i bar mgon po khro 36

bcu'i gtor chen/ de dag dang 'brel gar 'cham phyag len ma 'khrul ba dang / bskang gso dang / sgrol chog rgyun tshugs bcas so/ /gzhan yang rten gsum dang 'cham gar stabs rol chas sogs kyi skor ni dgon 'di'i lo rgyus gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /

bzhi pa/ bka' drin can gyi bla ma rnam gnyis kyi mdzad rnam bsdus pa dad pa'i 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i dga' tshal/dang po bla ma nor bu rin po che khong ni/ ye rtsag grong du yab jo phrug kurma dang / yum chos lu gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang por phru mas chos gos bzhin dkris te sku 'khrungs tshul dang /de nas yi ge 'bri klog sogs nas dpal sa skya'i gdan sa khag gi mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams dang / sga ston rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang legs pa dang / 'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo gros rin ngo/ che/ ye na mkhan rin po che chos 'phel rab rgyas sogs dam pa mang po rtsa ba'i bla ma bsten te zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi mtha' yas pa bzhes/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos blo gter dbang po'i zhal snga nas kyang smin grol gyi gdams pa dpag med dang/ sku nyid kyi chos gos dang dbu zhwa sogs kyang bstsal gnang mdzad/ de nas 'phral yun gyi bstan 'gro'i bde don gyi gzhi rtsa la dgongs te bla ma ya rdo mchog dang thugs gros legs par gnang zhing dka' ngal 38

brgya phrag du ma khyad bsad gnang nas bshad grwa gsar du btsugs pa sogs bstan 'gror sman pa'i don chen legs par grub ste dgung grangs don gsum thog bde bar gshegs so/ /bla ma rin po che rin chen seng ge'am ya rdo khong gi yab ni rgya lag yag ces pa dang / yum ya dga' gnyis kyi sras su ye rtsag grong du sku 'khrungs/ sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i bag chags sad cing chos la shin tu dad pas dpal ldan glang nag dbon pa'i chos gral zhugs te/ 'bri klog chos spyod kyi rim pa/ rnams sbyong brtson chen po'i sgo nas byang zhing chub pa mdzad pa ma zad/ dasa' ston rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang legs pa mchog la gtsug phud phul te mtshan rin chen seng ge gsol/ dam tshig dang sdom pa sku srog las kyang gces par bsrungs/ de nas dpal sa ngo mtshar gsum du zhabs kyis bcags nas skyes chen dam pa mang po la tshul bzhin bsten nas gsung ngag rin ngo/ che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa sdom pa gsum gyi chos kyi bdud rtsi mtha' yas pa mnos/ khyad par du rdzong gsar 'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo gros rin po cher rigs kyi bdag po bkur cing gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag cha lag dang bcas pas rdo rje theg pa'i dbang khrid dang / lung man ngag phra mo tshun chad kyang bo lo dang thos lo tsam du ma bzhag pa gsan bsam nyams bzhes kyi sgo nas dpal sa skya pa'i 39

lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rgyun bskyangs nas/ spyod lam rnam bzhi thams cad du de'i ngang las g.yo ba med pa mchog dman bar pa'i skye bo kun la byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems brtan pos gzhan gyi nad dang sdug bsngal sogs la bka' bsgo byin rlabs tsam gyis phan pa byung tshul gyi mngon rtogs bzang po thugs rgyud du mnga' ba'i tshul dang / dpal sa skya'i gdung rgyud phun tshogs pho brang gi bdag chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams las kyai rdo rje'i rgyud lam gyi dbang dang / dga' ston rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang legs pa dang / ye na mkhan rin po che chos 'phel rab rgyas sogs las kyang smin grol gyi gdams zab mang pos thugs kyi bum pa bzang po yongs su gtams/ sde gzhung mkhan rin po che ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'phel lam a 'jam las byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa dang / thub pa dgongs gsal/ spyi ljon brtag gsum/ zhen pa bzhi bral/ thar lam gsal sgron/ rdzogs chen snying thig gi 'pho ba sogs gsan/ ye na mchog sprul 'jam dbyangs las dpal 'jigs byed kyi pad/ mkha' spyod kyi be bum/ lam dus kyi sgom don/ rgyal sras lag len sogs kyi khrid sogs gsan bsam nyams bzhes dang / dpal kye rdo rje'i gzhi yi bsnyen pa sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes bcu cha'i sbyin bsregs dang bcas lhag lha phal che'i ljags bsnyen dang / kun rig dang / mkha' spyod/ 'byung 'dul 40

sogs kyi bsnyen sgrub tshad dang ldan pa legs grub dang / gzhan yang dam pa 'di pa ni lha ris thig tshad sogs la'ang shin tu mkhas pa'i snyan grags deng sang yang gnas pa dang / rig gsar skabs su dgon 'di'i rten gsum 'gang chen rnams rang srog dang bsdos te sbas skung gi gartse gras gnang ba ma zad/ skabs der byas rjes shin tu che ba'i ban rgan mang tsam yod tshul yang 'dug pas ngag rgyun gnas pa las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar bstan 'gro'i tshe srog la 'tshe ba'i dus ngan gyi rang stobs mngon sum du bstan te sems can gyi bde skyid nyams dma' ba'i skabs su dam pa 'di pas dpal sa skya'i chag med rnam pa bzhi'i nyam/sa len 'bral med rgyun skyong gnang zhing lkog lkog zhabs zhabs nas yul sde spyi yi bla ma lta bu gyur te bstan 'gro'i bde don la gcis tu brtson pa'i mdzad pa mthar phyin te dgung grangs don bzhi'i thog gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus so/ /sku gdung zhugs 'bul skabs nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od mi 'dra ba sna tshogs shar ba dang / yul lung spyi la bkra shis shing sems can la nad med pa dang lo legs pa sogs thun mong gi snang tshul bzang po byung ba deng sang yang grags so/ /41

lnga pa/ snga dus kyi bshad grwa'i skor mdo tsam brjod pa/ dgon 'di'i bstan pa'i srog shing du gyur pa gong du bstan pa'i bla ma rnam gnyis nas gshin gson gyi dad 'bul las byung ba'i dngos po yongs rdzogs bstan 'gro'i 'phral yun gyi bde don bzang po la dgongs te dang thog bshad grwa de rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing lug ste spyi lo 1955lor phyag btab gnang ba zhig yin yang / 'gal 'brel rtog 'dzing gi rang bzhin la brten nas khong rnam pa gnyis kyi bya ba la mi 'gas 'gog rkyen tshabs chen bzos yod par yang gsal te dper na/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis/yon tan med pa'i skye bo rnams/ /yon tan can la lhag par sdang / /gangs kyi yul du dgun skyes pa'i/ /lo tog ltas ngan yin zhes sgrogs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bod gangs can pa'i bla srog chos dang rig gzhung sogs 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu'i phugs re med pa'i nang khul gyi skya min ser min 'ga'i skabs der rang gi khe phan phran bu'i ched du 'phung dkrug sna tshogs bslangs nas rgyal ba'i bstan 42

pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel gsum gnang mkhan gyi bla ma 'di pa gnyis gyod ra la btsud cing bshad grwa btsugs rgyu la bar chad chen por brtsams te khong rnam pa gnyis la sku ngal tshad med byas tshul yang 'dug go/

drug pa/ dpal ldan glang nag dgon pa'i mkhan rabs rim pa byon pa g.yu yi phreng ba/bla ma rin po che nor bu dang / ya rdo khong rnam pa gnyis ku'i thugs gros bzhin/ bshad grwa'i mkhan po gdan 'dren zhu rgyu'i dka' don du/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen brtse chos kyi blo gros mchog la/ sde gzhung mkhan rin po che a 'jam gdan 'dren zhur rgyu gsol ba btab pa bzhin zhal bzhes gnang nas phebs pa'i mkhan rin po che 'di pa mkhan rabs dang po'o/ /de'i rjes su dpal sa skya'i bskos bla sbyin pa chos 'phel rin po che ste mkhan rabs gnyis pa'o/ /de'i rjes su mkhan 'jam dpa la tshe ring mchog ste mkhan rabs gsum pa'o/ /de'i rjes su ye na mchog sprul 'jam dbyangs te mkhan rabs bzhi pa'o/ /

bdun pa/ mkhan rabs lnga pa bla ma bsod nams dbang 'dus rin po che/bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu mo bya ste spyi lo 1933lor ri phug tshang zhes pa'i khyim rgyud du yab 'chi med tshe ring dang / yum bkra shis lha mtsho gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo brgyad kyi thog yab kyi mdun nas yi ge 'bri klog sogs legs par bslab gnang mdzad/ ye na mkhan rin chen chos 'phel rab rgyas mdun nas kye rdor rgyud lam gyi skor sogs zab chos mang po gsan/ dgung lo bco brgyad thog rdzong gsar bshad grwa la phebs te/ mkhan rin po che mdo srib thub bstan las rab tu byung / dam pa de nyid dang mkhan rin po che brag g.yab blo gros rnam gnyis las gzhung chen bcu gsum tshar gnyis gsan sbyangs yang dag mdzad/ mkhan rin po che mi nyag dam chos dang / mkhan rin po che mkhyen rab seng ge rnam gnyis las kyang mdo rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa la gsan sbyangs rgya cher gnang / skabs der rdzong gsar 'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo gros rin po che las/ dpal sa skya'i gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi dang / sgrub thabs kun 45

btus sogs/ kyi dbang khrid lung gsum mtha' yas pa gsan bzhes/ gnang / gzhan yang ra mgo mchog sprul dang / rgyal sras 'gyur med rdo rje rin po che/ sde gzhung mchog sprul kun dga' rgyal mtshan sogs las kyang mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs ci rigs pa la bsan bsam sgom pa'i nyams bzhes yang dag mdzad de lo drug bzhugs/ de nas brag g.yab blo gros rin po che'i mdun lo gsum bzhugs te zab rgyas chos kyi bdams pa'i thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su bkang /dgung grangs nyer dgu'i thog nas zas gos ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes mdzad cing / spyi lo 1982lo'i bar 'byung 'dul bsnyen mtshams dang / kun rig gzhi bsnyen/ kyai rdor gzhi bsnyen/ seng ge sgra/ brag rdzong ma/ sgrol dkar/ rdor sems/ tshe sgrub bcas kyi bsnyen sgrub tshad ldan legs grub dang / mdo sde bskal ba bzang ngo/ tshar brgya dang bcu gcig gser 'od dam pa tshar nyis brgya lhag zhal nas dag 'don mdzad/ de nas rgyal khab kyi srid jus je bzang byung ba la brten rang dgon gtsos nyan 'dod kyi slob ma mang po la byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa dang / dbu ma la 'jug pa/tshad ma rigs pa'i gter sogs dang / kyai rdor/ kun rig sogs bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs par mdzad pa'i snod ldan gyi gang zag rnams la 'chad spel gyi phrin las rgya che spel/ lo der tang dang rgyal khab kyis dgon pa'i bdag gnyer tsho chung gi gtso 'gan bzhes 46

dgos gsungs pa ltar dus de nas sku gshegs pa'i bar 'os 'gan yang dag bzhes/ spyi lo 1983lor rdzogs chen shrī seng bod yig slob grwar phebs te dbu ma la 'jug pa yang slob khrid mdzad/spyi lo 1985lor khrom gyi mkhan rin po che shes rab mdun nas bsnyen nga rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/ spyi lo 2003lor mkhan rin po che 'jam seng gtsos dam pa du ma las/ snga gzhug rnams su lam 'bras tshar gsum gsan bsam nyams bzhes legs par gnang / song zhus ltar sngon rjes ci rigs su rang dgon dang nya brag dgon sogs nas grwa ba mang po la dge tshul slong gi sdom rgyun yang legs par spel/ ngor e waṃ pa'i klu sding mkhan rin po che 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma'i zhal snga nas/ ngor lugs dkyil 'khor bdun dang / sbyangs rgyud bcu gnyis/ tsha 'jigs ngor 'jigs/ mkha' spyod byin rlabs bdun khrid dang bcas nga/ gsan bzhes dang / klu sding zhabs drung rin po che las/ sgru ba thabs phal cher gsan bzhes dang / thar rtse zhabs drung rin po che las ngor chen bka' 'bum sogs kyi ljags lung gsan/ mi ser tshos dad 'bul las byung ba'i dngos po gang byung phal cher dang / sku sgor gyi bris thang byin can mang po dang / bzhugs khang yang dgon gzhung la phul te bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'gran bral du mdzad tshul sogs mdor na skye chen dam pa'i rnam thar dang mthun pa'i mdzad pa 47

bzang po kho na'i dus 'da' ste dgung grangs don gsum phebs pa na nga 'di nas bde ba can du 'gro ba yin gsungs te dgongs pa chos dbyings su gshegs so/ /gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus tshul ston pa'i skabs rgyud nas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin sa g.yos pa dang 'brug gi sgra grag pa nyin mang po'i bar thugs dam la bzhugs te nang gi sems nyid dag pa phyi yi nam mkha' dag pa sogs kyi rtags khyad par ba byung ba ni yul sde thun mong gi mthong tshul gcig tu gyur pa sogs kyis mtshon mdzad rnam bsdus tsam mo/ /

brgyad pa/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rin chen gyi mdzad rnam rags tsam brjod pa dung dkar sgra dbyangs/de yang rgyal bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa zhes grags pa'i ba dan srid rtser g.yo ba de nyid kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa dpal glang nag dgon du mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa mtha' dag 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi sgo nas ches shin tu rgyas par mdzad pa la med du mi rung ba chos 'chad nyan byed yu la gyi slob grwa'am bshad grwa 'di dus skabs gsar pa'i nang du phyag 'debs pa po ni/dpal sa skya'i khri 'dzin pas/ bod yul mdo khams glang nag dgon pa'i sku zhabs 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rin chen 'di pa bsnyen sgrub mang po bgyis pa'i khar/ rang bstan la lhag bsam dor 'khur gyis mdzad bzang mang dag yod pa bcas la brten/ da lam 'di nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi ming gnas bsko gzhag bgyis pa yin na/ de lugs tshang mas brtsi bkur dang len dang / do bdag nas kyang mtshan gnas rjes 'brel bstan 'gror sman don 'grub pa'i 49

skyabs smon gang gzab bgyis 'thus bcas/ 'phags yul ra dza pur nas/ sa skya khri 'dzin pas/ 2006zla 1tshes 22dge ba la//zhes bka' bzang rdo rje spyi bor phebs pa'i phyag bris phyag bstar ma dngos su bstsal gnang byung ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rin chen nam ye shes tshe dbang rin po che khong ni/ bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing pho sprel te spyi lo 1944lo'i bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes sum cu'i nyin yab blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang yum sgrol ma lha mo gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung grangs bdun gyi thog dpal sa skya'i bskos bla sbyin pa chos 'phel rin po che'i zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs te yi ge 'bri klog nas rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig gi sngon 'gro'i khrid yig kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung sogs gsan bsam gnang rgyu'i chos kyi bag chags bzang po sad/ dgung grangs brgyad kyi thog rong pa tsha slob chung du phebs shing rgya bod kyi yig rigs lo drug la mkhas par sbyangs/ dgung grangs bcu bzhi'i thog mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen bla ma ya rdo mchog la gtsug phud phul nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/1955lor o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i 'phrin las kyi zlos gar kurma pa sku phreng bcu drug pa rang byung ye shes rig pa'i rdo rje rin po che/ dpal sa skya'i phun tshogs pho brang gi ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin po che sogs pe cin nas yar phebs pa'i lam 50

bar 'gro mgon thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang khrid lung dang bcas pas chos kyi bdud rtsi'i ro myong / spyi lo 1957lor dkar mdzes rdzong mi rigs dge 'os slob grwa ru phebs te lo 'go'i ring dge rgan du ma las rgya bod kyi rig gnas khag la gsan sbyangs legs par grub/ spyi lo 1966 73lo'i bar rong pa tsha'i 'dan ma shang gcig bi rtsis pa mdzad/ lo de nas shang des dmangs btsugs slob chung gi dge rgan lo dgur gnang / spyi lo 1982lor yas mas tang dang rgyal khab kyi slob gso'i go rim je bzang yar zla ltar gyur skabs slob chung gi dge rgan tshad ldan du bsgyur nas lo 'khor brgyad tsam du slob ma brgya phrag du ma la lhag bsam rma med pas rgya bod kyi yig rtsis sogs kyis slob khrid dang / sgrig lam/ kun spyod/ slob gso bcas phyogs gang thad nas rgyal khab kyi 'char bkod bzhin bya ba legs grub gnang ngo / /spyi lo 1990lor si khron zhing chen nang bstan slob gling gi gdan drangs pa ltar phebs nas slob ma rnams la sum rtags dag gsum dang / rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa/dpal sa skya'i zhen pa bzhi bral sogs lo 'ga'i ring la 'chad spel gyi 'phrin las rgya cher bskyangs shing bar skabs shig tu rgyal khab kyi las gnas las ngal gso zhus/ dus de dag gi snga gzhug rnams su dpal lha rgyal dgon pa'i bla ma ngag dbang bzang po'am dge 51

'dun rin po che las dpal kyai rdo rje'i rgyud lam gyi dbang gsan bzhes dang / rgyal ba 'od mtha' yas kyi rnam rol kun gzigs paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan rin po che las rgyud rgyal 'jigs byed dpa' gcig bi dbang / mkhas grub kyi go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa mkhan chen pad+ma tshe dbang lhun grub rin po che las spyod 'jug sher le dang / nag rtsis kyi skor/ brag 'go'i dge bshes blo bzang don grub rin po che las lam gtso rnam gsum dang bdud rtsi thigs pa/ dge bshes dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros rin po che las bod kyi yi ge'i spyi rnam blo gsal 'jug ngogs/ dge bshes blo bzang snyan grags rin po che las tshad ma rigs gter/ mkhan chen 'jigs med phun tshogs rin po che las smon lam thams cad kyi rgyal po bzang spyod kyi tshig don 'grel ba zab rgyas/ bla ma rin po che kurma bsod nams las dpal rgyal ba bka' brgyud lugs kyi zhi byed gcod kyi skor sogs gsan bzhes legs par gnang ba ma zad/ khrom gyi mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs blo bzang dpal ldan nam mkhan shes rab rin po che rigs kyi bdag por gyur te dam pa de las sor byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa dang / lugs gnyis kyi sems bskyed/ dpal kye rdo rje'i rgyud lam gyi dbang / 'jigs byed/ mkha' spyod/ phur pa/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud/ mgon po phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dbang khrid 52

lung gsum/ mgon ngo/ tshogs bdag phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dbang khrid lung gsum/ sgrub thabs kun btus/ dri med rnam gnyis sogs kyi dbang dang / dpal sa skya'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i nyams len gyi gzhi'am sngon du 'gro ba la/ thog mar pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam dang thun mong ba snang ba gsum gyi lam zhes bya ba/ ma dag pa'i snang ba/ rnal 'byor nyams kyi snang ba/ dag pa'i snang ba bcas gsum dang / dngos gzhi gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i gzhi lam 'bras bu rnams rgyud gsum du dril nas nyams su len pa la/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba skyong ba/ lus thabs rgyud la dbang bzhi dang 'brel ba'i lam bsgom pa/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i rgyud la sku lnga ye shes lnga'i yon tan 'char ba ste rgyud gsum sogs dang / lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med nyams len gnad dang sbyar tshul/ rdzogs chen sems nyid rang grol gyi khrid/snying tig gi 'pho ba/ rgyal ba'i sras po rnams kyi lag len so bdun ma'i khrid sogs mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i smin grol gyi gdams pas chos kyi bdud rtsi myang ste bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa btang mi bra ba'i nyams len gyi rgyun bskyangs/ yang chos rje mchog sprul nyi ma'i zhabs pad yun ring du bsten nas dpal sa skya'i snang gsum dang rgyud gsum/ spyod 'jug sher le/ dbu ma 'jug pa sogs gsan bsam nyams ba zhes legs 53

grub dang / khrom gyi grub dbang lung rtogs rgyal mtshan nam mkhan a chung rin po che las sde gzhung mchog sprul rin po che'i rdo rje'i ljags las thon pa'i 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi zin bris dang / dpal ldan sa skya pa'i snang gsum dang rgyud gsum/ slob dpon shrī sedha dang / lo chen be+e ro tsa na sogs nas brgyud pa'i lta grub rang byung gi ye shes chos nyid kun tu bzang po'i klong du chos can gyi snang ba thams cad rang snang bkod pa'i rgyan tsam las 'ching grol dang /shar bya shar byed du ma grub pas/ yod med dang / yin min gang du'ang mi dpyod par ye grol phyogs 'byams chen por gtan la 'bebs pa rdzogs chen a ti yo ga'i nang gses bya bral klong gi sde'i smin byed kyi dbang / grol byed kyi khrid/ rgyab rten lung chos dang bcas pa legs par gsan te lam rim pa gnyis la rtsal bton/ klu lding mkhan rin po che bstan pa'i nyi ma las ngor lugs dkyil 'khor bdun gyi dbang dang / gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag thams cad phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi dus sbyor dang 'brel ba bla med kyi rgyud dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang khrid lung gsum dang mkha' spyod byin rlabs/ rgyud rdo rje'i phreng ba/ dpal sa skya'i lam 'bras sogs gsan bsam sgom pa'i nyams bzhes dang / klu lding zhabs drung rin po che dang / thar rtse zhabs drung rin po che rnam gnyis las sgrub thabs kun btus kyi lung gsan/ sde dge'i sgos bla 54

rin po che las brag rdzong ma phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dbang khrid lung dang bcas pa yang dag mnos/ rang dgon gyi bla ma bsod nams dbang 'dus rin po che las/ dpal kye rdo rje'i khrid zab mo dang /phyag rdo'i zab khrid/ thub pa dgongs gsal/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'jug pa'i gzhung bzang yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po sogs gsan bsam rgya cher dang / dpal sa skya'i mkhan klu gros rgya mtsho las/ mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs phyi nang gsang gsum bcas rgyas par gsan bsam legs grub gnang bar mdzad do/ /de ltar ris med 'gro ba'i dpal mgon mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams la mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas bsten tshul mdo tsam zhus grub bo/ /lhag pa'i lha de dag gi gzhi bsnyen ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul yang / dpal gsang ba'i bdag po 'byung po 'dul byed kyi bsnyen mtshams dang / kyai rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen/ kun rig rnam snang gi gzhi bsnyen/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dam 'jam dpal gshin rje/ phur pa/ sgrol dkar/ brag rdzong ma phyi nang gsang gsum bcas kyi bsnyen sgrub sogs legs par gnang ngo / /yang bar skabs shig tu dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing sa ru yang phyag phebs te jo shāka rnam gnyis gtsos rten byin can rnams la zhal gser bsgron cing mchod 'bul dang / 'dus pa'i tshogs la'ang gya rnam pa'i bsnyen bkur/ slong 55

bas 'tsho ba'i lus can nyam thag pa rnams la'ang bza' ba dang /btung ba/ gyon pa la sogs bka' drin bla na med pas bskyangs te/gnas 'gang chen rnams la phyag dang zhabs bskor bcas bstan 'gror sman pa'i thugs smon yang dag mdzad zhor dpal sa skya'i kha'u brag rdzong zhes pa'i dben pa'i khang bu byin can du mgon po'i bsnyen mtshams zla gcig lhag kyang bzhugs so/ /gangs can bod kyi 'gro ba mi dang tha dad du gyur pa'i sems can mang po thar pa'i lam bzang por dkri bar mdzad pa'i tshul yang / rgyal sa pe cin dang / hrang he/ kong kru'u/ hran kren/ khun min/ ho nan/ ho pa'e/ hu'u nan/ klog pa'i/ ku'e kru'u/ h+phu'u jan/tung pa'e/ khren tu'u/ shang kung / the wan shin ca phu'o/ a ris/ rus si sogs gdul bya'i sems can dpag tu med pa la/ theg pa thun mong gi lam sbyong blo ldog rnam pa bzhi las/dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' bar bsams nas snying po len dgos par gdams pa/ 'chi ba mi rtag par bsams nas rtag 'dzin gyi blo sna stung bar gdams pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la bsams nas 'dod yon la zhen pa spong bar gdams pa/ las 'bras mi bslu bar bsams nas spang blang gi gnas la 'jug ldog byed par gdams pa dang bzhi las/dang po dpal sa skya'i khri 'dzin pas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi 56

mtshan thob phul ba'i 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rin chen 'di pas gdul bya'i yul du gyur ba'i 'gro ba de dag la spyir dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu tshang ba'i mi lus rin po che ni rgyu dpe grangs gsum gyi sgo nas rnyed dka' tshul gyi gdams pa bstan cing / de ltar rnyed kyang snying po tshul bzhin du ma blangs pa'i nyes dmigs dang / ji ltar snying po len dgos tshul sogs don zab gnad 'dus kyi sgo nas khrid rim dang po byed cing bstan pa'i tshul dang /gnyis pa phyi snod ri brag yul gling sogs phyi snod 'jig rten spyi'i bkod pa mi rtag pa'i tshul gyi gdams pa dang / bcud kyi 'gro ba 'khor bsgyur gyi thob dang dbang thang lta bu yang mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin dang / bye brag tu da lta rang gi bdag tu bzung ba'i khang khyim longs spyod rnams kyang 'chi ba'i tshe khab dang skud pa tsam yang khyer dbang med pa ma zad shin tu gces pa'i rang gi lus kyang shul du bzhag ste las dkar nag kho na'i rjes su 'gro zhing 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang gi gnas su sdug bsngal myong dgos pa sogs dpe don du ma'i sgo nas khrid rim gnyis pa byed cing bstan pa'i tshul dang /gsum pa 'jig rten 'khor ba'i gnas la 'phral snang gi bde skyid cung zad re yod kyang / de ni yun ring por mi gnas pa mi rtag cing mi brtan pa dper na dbyar dus kyi 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar re zhig bar mdzes pa snang yang sprin pa mkha' la deng ba'i rang 57

bzhin ltar bden par med pa/ 'khor ba'i 'phral snang gi bde ba thams cad kyang de dang 'dra ba myur du nges par 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal las ma 'das pa yin pas khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas ris su mi chags par thar pa dam pa'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa la myur du brtson dgos par gdams pa sogs khrid rim gsum pa byed cing bstan pa'i tshul dang /bzhi pa dge sdig gi rgyu chung dus kyang 'bras bu bde sdug gi rgyu chen po 'gyur ba yang dper na zhing sa gshin por la sa bon nyung ngu tsam btab na yang de la rkyen chu lud drod gsher sogs dang legs par 'phrad na/ ston gyi dus su 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa smin pa bzhin du sgo gsum gyi dge ba chung ngu yin yang / thabs khyad par can mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob 'dod kyi theg chen sems bskyed kyis rtsis zin na de la theg pa mchog gi chos zhes pa yin pas/ las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i gnas tshul la bsams te rnam dkar dge ba'i las la 'bad pa gang thub byed dgos pa dang / de bzhin du rgyu mi dge ba chung ngus kyang 'bras bu nyon mongs dug lnga'i stobs je cher rdzogs nas rang rgyud kyi rnam dkar dge ba'i las rgya cher yod kyang skad cig nyid la 'joms par byed pa yin pas/ dge sdig spang blang gi gnas la 'jug ldog ci nus re bgyis pa bya rgyu'i 58

khrid rim don gsal gnad 'dus bstan pa'i rjes su/ chos kyi thog mar dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro dgos tshul dang / skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya/ skyabs 'gro'i phan yon/ bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed tshul/ gnyen po stobs bzhis sgo nas sgrib pa ji ltar sbyong tshul sogs gnad la phan pa'i chos dang / khrid rim de dag gi bar bar rnams su 'khor ba dang ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal spyi bye brag sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i chos legs par bstan cing 'gro ba de dag blo las su rung ba bya ba'i tshul bzang po'i mdzad pa dang /gzhan yang rgya bod gang gi sman pas kyang phan thogs ma byung ba'i yun ring gyi nad pa dang / nad thog gdon gyis zin te rnam shes gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i smyon pa 'ga' re la ni bka' bsgo bgegs bskrad tsam gyis nad gdon las grol ba dang / dbul zhing phongs pa'i khyim dud kha shas la ni gsur mchod dang tshogs 'khor sogs phul bas bde zhing skyid pa'i dpal yar zla ltar 'phel ba dang / sho sbag dang du chang sogs la longs su spyod rgyu med na 'dug blo med pa lta bu'i skye bo pho mo mang po la spang blang gi gnad legs par bstan te bza' mi khyim tshang bar gyi bde 'jags spel ba dang /yul sde phan tshun bar la mthun sgril dang bde 'jags dgos tshul gyi zhal gsung rin thang dang bral ba mang po gnang ste grub 'bras phul du byung ba du ma yang byung 'dug go/59

smin grol gyi gdams ngag ji ltar bstsal ba'i tshul yang /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang / gsung mchog yi ge drug ma'i sgom bzlas phan yon dang bcas pa/ gu ru'i dbang dang /sirnyi'i khrid lung / sman bla/ sgrol ma/ rta phyag khyung gsum/ rig byed ma/ dzam lha rigs lnga/ 'jam dbyangs/ tshe rta zung 'brel/ 'jigs byed/ rdzogs chen a ti yo ga'i nang gses bya bral klong sde'i skor gyi dbang khrid lung gsum/ snang gsum dang rgyud gsum sogs mdor na dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gser chos bcu gsum kyi dbang khrid lung gsum gyis 'gro ba mang po smin grol gyi lam bzang por bkod tshul mu tig bstar la brgyus pa ltar byung ba'i legs par bshad pa'i snying don zab mo dang / yul de dag gi skye dgu mchog dman rnams kyis dad gus spro gsum gyi sgo nas phul ba'i dngos rdzas rnams rang gzhan kun 'phral dang yun gyi dge mtshan ma lus par gsal ba'i slad du/ 'phro brlag dang chud mi gzon par mdzad de rang dgon gyi dam pa gong ma'i phyag len gyi rgyun mthud cing mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong du spel ba'i phyir bshad grwa legs par zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i 'dun pa thugs la shar te spyi lo 2003lo'i zla ba bzhi ba'i nang dad ldan mi ser yongs la re bskul nan tan zhus shing khang las gyang brdung sogs kyi 'go btsugs pa nas spyi lo 2005lo'i bar slob ma bzhugs 60

gnas bang ba bco brgyad dang / gtsug lag khang ka mig so lnga can dang / ja khang sogs legs grub byung / gtsug lag khang du rten gyi gtso bo rgyu zangs gser las grub pa'i thub dbang gtso 'khor gsum bzhengs rgyu bcas sngon rjes su 'gro song btang dang gtong mus yongs rdzogs sdom rtsis ltar byas na mi dmangs dngul sgor khri nyis brgya las mi nyung bar 'gro nges bzhin gtong bar bya rgyur zhal thag rbad de bcad cing gzigs pa rnam par dge bas mjug legs par bskyangs rgyu yin zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang gong du zhus pa'i 'gro song de dag gi khongs su mi gtogs pa sgor khri nyer gnyis tsam gyis rgyu li dkar dmar las grub pa'i 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyi sku stong tsho gcig gdan drangs te bshad grwa'i gtsug lag khang du 'jog gnang mdzad rgyu yang yod ces gsungs/ rang dgon gyi rab tu byung ba thos bsam don du gnyer ba yo byad kyis cung zad phongs pa'i grwa nyer gnyis tsam la yang lo bcu'i ring lo re grwa re la sgor sum brgya re gnang bzhin dang gnang rgyu yang mdzad do/ /dus lan gcig dang gnyis ma yin par yang nas yang du sgyu ma'i nor rdzas la sred zhen spangs nas mchod sbyin la spro ba'i brtul zhugs rma med pa ston pa'ang 'di lta ste/ snga gzhug rnams su dkar mdzes dang lha ldan sogs la rang dgon gyi bla grwa rin chen chos 'phel dang / bskal bzang rgya mtsho gnyis/ slad mar dbang 'dus 61

dang / bskal bstan bcas khrid de dad ldan ser skya yongs la slong mor byas nas rang dgon du phul ba'i mchod rdzas kyi bye brag rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che cha tshang gcig lugs sku lnga/ 'dam sku gcig zhal 'bag gnyis/ rol mo che chung cha nyi shu dang / sil snyan cha bcu/ rgya gling cha gcig 'khar rnga gnyis/ mchod cha che chung cha gnyis/ spos phor 'phags mchog ma bcas cha 'dzoms/ 'cham gos gcig gos chen gyi yol ba/ mu tig las grub pa'i gdugs dang rgyal mtshan/ gdan gsum/ 'tshogs gdan ring po gcig bcas so//gzhan yang dbyar gnas thog mar 'go btsugs skabs nyid nas gor gcig stong sum brgya phul ba dang / dbyar gnas spyi pa lo gsum gyi ring la bskal bzang rgya mtsho dang lhan du byung ba'i byas rjes ma dngul sgor lnga stong dgon gzhung la rtsis sprad legs par mdzad/ yang nyid nas chu 'then byed gnyis/ dngul 'jog snod kyi lcags sgam gcig grwa mang la gzan sham cha 'grig dang / ngal rtsol gyi gos/ dpal sa skya'i zhal 'don phyogs sgrig kun rig cho ga'i phyag dpe/ rlangs 'khor bzhi brgyad lnga zhes pa'i rtags can gcig bcas gnang ba dang / bkra shis dar rgyas dgon du rol mo gcig dang sil snyan gcig g.yar dgon tshang la rol mo gcig dang sgor tshig stong lnga brgya/ dgon gsar tshang la rol mo gcig rdzong gsar ga'u ri khrod du gtsug lag khang bskyar gso'i rten sgor tshig khri/62

dkar mdzes su mkhar nang dgon pa'i gtsug lag khang bskyar gso'i rten sgor sum khri lnga stong / rgyal bstan mchog sprul rin po che'i slob grwa ru gyon chas do bo lnga/ 'dan ma shang gi ru khag bdun tsam gyi ngal rtsol ba la gyon chas rlangs 'khor gang gnang ba sogs mchod dang sbyin pa'i gnas la legs par brtson pa ma zad/ dkar mdzes rdzong bod yig slob 'bring du sgor sum khri'i ma dngul gnang ste rgyal khab kyi dngul khang du bzhag cing dngul skyed gang yod lo ltar sbyangs 'bras legs thon gyi slob ma la sku nyid kyi bya dga' zhes pa'i srol bzang po yang gsar du btsugs/ gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa chen po'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar dpe bskrun gyi ched du sgor tshig khri lnga stong tsam phul te mdo dbus khams gsum du dpal sa skya pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar sa khyab rdo khyab ltar yod pa'i phyag rjes rmad du byung ba dang / khyad par rgyal phyi nang gang du phebs kyang byams dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems yang dag pa'i lta ba sogs kyis rgyud bskul te spyi 'dzam gling zhi bde yong ba'i thugs smon zab mo dang /bye brag bar do'i sems can la dmigs te gsur mchod 'dod dgu'i mchod sprin spros tshul yang / 'jam mgon dpal sprul gyis/ chos kyi sgra tsam yang thos ma myong pa'am/ bla ma dang lha la dad pa spu tsam med pa/ chos kyi phan ma thogs par srid pa bar ma do'am/63

yi dwags kyi sde tshan gang rung du skyes pa/ 'khrul snang kho na la spyod nas nyin mtshan bo log tu shar ba/ 'khyags ltog skom gsum gyis gdung ba/ bkres snang dang zas snang rgyun chad med pa/ rtag tu sgo dang khyim nyul zhing / zas skom dang 'byor pa mthong yang longs spyod rgyu med pa/ 'jigs skrag dang zhe sdang gis mnar ba/ shi mig gson la blta ba/ shi lag gson la gzed pa/ shi sems gson la chags pa/lag pa bzed kyang gzhan gyis mi mthong / ma mthong tsa na zhe snang langs ba/ yul mun rub ltar snang ba/ lus grib ma ltar 'dug pa/kha char dang bu yug gi gdung ba/ sngo la gnag pa/ skya la skem pa/ser la btsa' ba/ bzhin mi sdug pa/ skad ngan pa/ zas la re ba/skom la rigadung ba sogs zhes gsungs pa ltar las ngan lus ngan gyi sems can dpag tu med pa rnams kyi don du gsur mchod 'dod dgu'i longs spyod spel te/ bla ma dang yi dam lha'i thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu sogs la brten nas myur du dag pa'i zhing khams su bgrod nus pa'i bsngo smon zab mo'i thugs dam la rtag tu brtson pa lhur len pa ma zad/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rnams kyi bskul ngor skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i snying por gyur pa bla ma dang /sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun te yul dam pa rnams la brten nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug skyid pa sogs la dmigs te bsod nams dang ye 64

shes kyi tshogs rlabs po che rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir bza' bca' btung ba'i rdzas dpag tu med pa dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi sgo nas sa paṇa bla mchod dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod dang / dpal ldan gur gyi mgon po'i tshogs 'khor sogs rgya cher bskor te 'gro ba'i re ba bskang ba'i don mdzad tshul yang mang ngo / /gzhan yang shin tu ngo mtshar zhing ya mtshan dgos pa zhig la sems can 'chi la nges pa mang po'i tshe dang srog bskyabs pa'i tshul yang grong khyer gyi nya gsod tshong ra nas lan grangs du mar nya sbrul 'bu srin sogs las ngan gyi sems can bgrang gis mi langs pa'i tshe srog bslus te rlangs 'khor mang pos chu gnas su bskyal te sdug bsngal gyi gnas las re zhig grol ba mdzad tshul sogs kyi rnam thar dang / yang spyi lo 2008lo'i zla bcu pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin nang sog sa khul gyi khyim chen zhig gi zur nas myur bar nyid du gsad rgyu'i sems can wa mo nyis brgya nyi shu'i tshe srog bslus te ri skyes srog chags srung skyob ra ba'i nags tshal du bskyal nas gnas skabs bde ba'i ngal gso chen po byin/ spyi lo 2004lo'i khams nyag rong dpal e waṃ dgon pa'i sa skya'i smon lam chen mo dbu btsugs nas da lta'i bar bla ma dang sbyin bdag gnyis ku'i thugs 'gan nyid kyis bzhes te lo re 'gro song sgor nyis khri re phul ba bcas bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'gran bral du mdzad tshul bzang po co 65

dag ni sku nyid kyis zhal gsungs ltar bkod pas chad lhag nor 'khrul gyi skyon med pa dang / 'dri rtogs legs par yang zhus te ji dang ji bzhin pa ma gtogs sgro btags med pa/ rang gi shes nus rtsal du bton nas bsam pa thag pas bris pa 'di la yid brton du mi rung ba med snyam pa dang / skye 'gro'i phan bde'i rtsa lag bla na med par bskrun pa'i mdzad rjes 'di lta bu ni rang dgon la mtshon na de sngon byung med pa'i gnas tshul dngos thog bden 'tshol gyi sgo nas je rgyas je bzang zla ba yar ngo la chas pa bzhin thun mong gi gzigs ngor gsal bar gyur pa dang / yang spyi lo 2008lor khams pa'i mi sna grags can gyi lo rgyus dpe bskrun bya rgyu'i don la sgor nyis khri gnang ba'i mdzad rjes dang / mdo khams tre hor rong pa tsha ba'i lo rgyus sngon med legs bshad dung gi sgra dbyangs dpe bskrun bya rgyu la'ang rogs skyor gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon par byas te mdzad rnam bsdus tsam zhus grub bo/ /'og tu gsal ba'i sa dgon rnams la'ang rin po che 'di pas gzigs pa rnam pa dge ba'i legs par skyong ba'i tshul sogs ni dgon pa so so'i lo rgyus bsdus don las byung ba bzhin shes par bya'o/ /66

e waṃ 'dzam gling bkra shis dgon gyi lo rgyus bsdus tsam brjod pa pad+ma dkar po'i chun po/de yang khams phyogs nyag rong rdzong gi mnga' 'og dpal ldan sa skya pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'dzin pa'i chos kyi sde e waṃ bkra shis dgon zhes pa thog mar ji ltar byung ba'i tshule ni bod rab byung bzhi pa'i gzhug lnga pa'i mgo tsam yas mas 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che khong / mi'i dbang po rgyal bu go dan gyis gdan drangs pa'i lam bar yul der dngos su byon nas sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs pa sogs mdzad cing e waṃ dgon 'di phyag btab/ de nas rim bzhin dpazlo sa skya pa'i bstan pa je rgyas gyur te gna' dus gtsang ngor nas lo gsum re'i mtshams su mkhan po re mngags srol byung yang / rjes su g.yu ri bla ma zhes pas mkhan po mdzad nas gtsang ngo nas byon mi dgos pa dang / dam pa 'di pas dgon pa nyams gso dang bstan pa dar rgyas kyi mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i rjes/ rig 'dzin klong gsal snying po byon nas 'gro phan 'phrin las rgya cher skyong ste chos yul smad du'ang rdo rje phag mo'i gnas sgo phyes shing rdo la zhabs rjes bzhag pa sogs grub pa'i mtshan ma dang / sgrub phug tu dpal o rgyan chen po'i sku rten bzhengs pa sogs mdzad cing sa cha der da lta yang phag mo'i gnas 67
