zhes byin rlabs can du grags/ de rjes khrom dge mkha' spyod rin po che dang / grags pa chos kyi 'od zer rnam gnyis byon skabs bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma la bltos te e waṃ zhes pa'i mjug tu 'dzam gling bkra shis zhes pa dgon pa'i mtshan gsar du snon te e waṃ 'dzam gling bkra shis dgon zhes pa gsol/ khyad par khrom dge mkha' spyod rin po ches dbon 'di'i lcags ri'i nang du dwangs gtsang chab kyi gter sgo phyes te 'gram du/ phyis su shing yal ga dang lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu sogs shing rigs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig skyes pa ma zad/ gter nas bton pa'i chu de'i rang bzhin rang dwangs la gtsang ba/ chu snod zo ba brgya dus gcig tu blangs kyang cung zad kyang nyung du mi 'gro ba dang / ma blang yang mang du mi 'gro ba/ dbyar dus su rgyas te gang ba/ dgun dus su bri ste nyung du 'gro ba sogs med pa'i ya mtshan can gyi chu gter da lta mig gi dga' ston du longs su spyod rgyu yod bzhin pa 'di gter nas bton pa'o//de nas bar skabs su grub pa'i dbang phyug 'ja' lus pa chen po pad+ma bdud 'dul rin po che dang / sprul pa'i gter ston bsod rgyal rin po che/ dbon po tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ gzung shul bya bral/ glag bla chos 'grub/ gter chen 'gro 'dul gling pa sogs mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i sa la bzhugs pa'i skyes bu dam pa du ma byon te bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad do/ / 68

bod rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu khyi nas shing glang bar dang /spyi lo 1862—1865lo yas mas nyag sked dpon dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung 'khrug skabs nyag sked dpon gyis dgon 'di mer bsregs/ de'i rjes su stong dpon gyang pa gdugs dkar gyi ring la mkhas shing grub pa'i bla ma chos bzang gis dgon pa nyams gso legs par mdzad tshul dang / dam pa 'di pa ka to le dge tshang zhes pa'i khyim rgyud du rab byung bco lnga'i nang tshan du sku 'khrungs/chung ngu'i dus nas 'don slob gnyer la 'bad brtson dang blo kha dge ba'i chos la phyogs shing gyis pa phal pa lta bu zhig min stabs/khong gi slob dngo/na dpal ldan rgya mtsho zhes pas rten 'brel shin tu legs/ da skabs dgon 'di nyams zhig gyur te grwa pa/ med rung rjes su e waṃ dgon pa dar zhing rgyas pa na khyed dgon 'di'i bstan pa 'i bdag po ru 'gyur ces lung bstan/ dgung lo nyer gcig thog mkhan blo gros snying po las bsnyen par rdzogs te mtshan chos dpal bzang po gsol/ sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams phra mo tshun chad kyang mig 'bras ltar srung zhing tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs/ dpal sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin du ma las gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i dbang khrid lung man ngag yongs su rdzogs pas thugs kyi bum pa bzang po gtams par mdzad do/ /de nas dam pa de nyid 'gro ba mang po'i mchod pa'i bste gnas 69

gcig po lta bur gyur pa na/ o rgyan 'gro 'dul gling pa'am rgya tshang gter chen gyis/ 'phags pa/'i gnas rten ba ku la yi sprul pa ru ngos bzung / mthar a mo gling zhes pa'i sa cha zhig tu sku gshegs tshul sogs lung du bstan/ gshin gson rnams kyi dad 'bul las byung ba'i dngos po yongs su rdzogs pas dgon 'di nyams gsos mdzad de bstan pa bskyangs/ sku tshe'i mjug tu tsha bu dang dud tshang zhig 'thab 'dzing byung rkyen gyis yul byol tu 'go log phyogs su phebs pa na/ a mo gling zhes pa'i spang leb zhig tu slebs pa'i tshe gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus so/ /de nas rim bzhin bla ma 'jam dbyangs dang / blo gros rgya mtsho/rdo rje tshe dbang / bkra shis chos dar bcas kyis dgon 'di'i bstan pa la thugs 'gan rgya cher mdzad yod do/ /bshad sgrub gnyis kyi srol ji ltar tshugs tshul/rong ston shes bya kun gzigs kyi skye sprul du grags pa'i sde dge'i rdzong gsar bshad grwa'i mkhan rin po che 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rnam rgyal dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos blo gter dbang po'i yang srid dkon mchog dbang po rnam gnyis byon nas dpal sa skya pa'i gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i dbang khrid lung man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa zla ba lnga tsam la gnang 70

ngo / /de nas bzung bshad grwa thog mar 'go tshugs/ de rjes bshad grwa'i mkhan po mi nyag mkhan rin po che kun dga' phun tshogs kyis mdzad nas yun ring bzhugs/ skabs der bshad grwar zhugs mkhan grwa bdun cu tsam yod ces gsungs po/ /de rjes mkhan rin po che bkra shis chos dar mkhan po mdzad nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi phrin las rgya cher gnang ngo / /bod zla dang po'i nang kun rig sgrub mchod dang / rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub mchod do/ /bod zla drug pa'i nang dbyar gnas zla ba gcig bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang bskang gso bcas yod do/ /dgon 'di'i tshogs rten dang sgrub 'jugs gtong sgo sogs kyi skor/ches snga ba'i dus su chos rgyal 'phags pa rin po che phebs pa'i dus su dad rdzas yon 'bul sogs la brten nas dge 'dun pa rnams 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen byung yod tshul dang / phyis su bla ma chos bzang gi sku ring la stong dpon gyang pa gdugs dkar gyi dus su zhing pa dud grangs lnga brgya dang / 'brog dud sum cu lhag tsam lha sde ru bzhag nas dge 'dun pa rnams la 'tsho ba sbyar ba'i srol byung yod do/ /— 71

dgon sde gzhan dang 'brel tshul/dpal sa skya'i e waṃ dgon pa 'di'i chos rgyud mched pa'i dgon sde ni/ rag shul dgon/ hāḥrtse dgon/ rgya shod dgon/ 'ba' shod dgon/ dgon sar dgon/ byang dge dgon/ ra lo dgon/dbang bzhi dgon/ gzhis ka dgon bcas so/ /g.yu ri bla ma'i sku ring la/ rag shul dgon dang rgya shod dgon gnyis sa thag ring stabs e waṃ dgon du yong mi dgos pa'i zhal bzhes gnang / rag shul dgon dang / hāḥrtse dgon gnyis ni phyis su bla sprul 'ga' re'i sku ring grub mtha' gsang sngags rnying mar gyur to/ /phyis kyi gnas tshul 'ga' zhigarig gsar skabs rten dang brten nga bcas brlags tshul dgon sde spyi dang 'dra/ de rjes tang dang rgyal khab kyi srid jus je bzang gyur te bla grwa spyi dang mi ser tshos dad 'bul ngal rtsol zung 'brel gyis dgon pa nyams gsos byed sgo legs par spel dang /khyad par mchog sprul dkon mchog dbang po li thang nas ched phebs mdzad de yul dgon ser skya yongs la dpal sa skya'i 'khor 'das dbyer med dang 'pho ba'i gdams ngag rten gsum 'gangs chen sogs gnang ba ma zad/ rjes su'ang lam 'bras slob bshad 72

gnang ba bya rgyu zhal gyis bzhes tshul yang gsungs so/ /de rjes 'gro 'dul gling pa'i yang srid mchog sprul rig 'dzin rnam rgyal byon nas yul mi ser skya kun la 'pho ba'i gdams ngag dang / skabs der byung ba'i dad 'bul gyi dngos po rnams dgon pa nyams gso'i slad du gnang ba ma zad/ slad mar dpal e waṃ dgon pa'i bshad grwa'i mkhan por bzhugs rgyu yang zhal bzhes gnang ngo / /phyis su bzhag gsar sprul sku'i gdung rgyud ma nyams pa a tshang mchog gis thugs 'gan bzhes nas dgon pa nyams gsos mdzad/ mchog sprul pad+ma ye shes nas kyang mchod cha sogs gnang ste rgyab skyor legs par gnang tshul dang / dbon po ye shes bzang gos kyang de bzhin du thugs khur dang rgyab skyor bzang po gnang ngo / /de'i rjes su dpal ldan glang nag dgon pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen mo 'jam dbyangs kun dasa' rin chen mchog gis spyi lo 2004lo nas dpal e waṃ dgon 'di'i sa skya'i smon lam chen mo dbu btsugs nas da lta'i bar bla ma dang sbyin bdag gnyis ku'i thugs 'gan bzhes te lo re 'gro song sgor nyis khri re phul te dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa mi nub dar zhing rgyas par mdzad bzhin pa sogs kyis mtshon dpal e waṃ 'dzam gling bkra shis dgon gyi lo rgyus bsdus tsam mo/ /dgon 'di'i rten gsum dang mchod chas 'cham gar stabs sogs dgon 'di'i lo rgyus gzhan las shes par 73

bya'o/ /phur mgo dgon gyi lo rgyus rags tsam brjod pa bsil zer dkar po'i thigs phreng /de yang phur mgo dgon ni rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags khyi ste spyi lo 1790lor ngor e waṃ chos ldan nas gdan rabs so sum pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi rnam 'phrul mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong dgung lo so dgu'i thog mdo khams sde dge rgyal po'i gdan sar spyan drangs/ dus de yas mas khong bis thog mar stag ri lhun po'i mgo la phyag btab gnang bas phur mgo dgon zhes par 'bod/ dgon 'di thog mar rdo rje dgon zhes pa dang gcig yin mod nang ma mthun nas spos pa'i lo rgyus kyang 'dug phur maso sprul sku sku phreng gnyis pa rin chen kun dga' rgya mtshos rgya bskyed mdzad cing rten bzhengs byas tshul sogs gsal lo/ /sgrub mchod/zla ba dang po'i tshes dgu nas bco lnga bar rnam rgyal ma'i sgrub mchod/ zla de'i tshes nyer gnyis nas nyer drug bar kun rig sgrub mchod/ zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gsum nas bco lnga'i bar mi 'khrug pa'i sgrub mchod/ zla gsum pa'i nang rab gnas chen po'i sbyin sreg 74

nyin bdun/ zla ba lnga pa'i nang gnas bcu nyin lnga/ zla drug pa'i tshes bco lnga nas zla bdun pa'i zla mjug bar dbyar gnas/ zla brgyad pa'i nang kun rig sgrub mchod nyin brgyad/ zla dgu ba'i nang sa skya gong ma rnam lnga'i dgongs rdzogs nyin lnga/ zla bcu pa'i nang kun rig sgrub mchod nyin gnyis/ zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer gcig nas bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer gcig bar dgun mtshams/ zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer gnyis nas nyer dgu bar mgon po khro bcu'i gtor sgrub bcas so//deng gi gnas tshul/spyi lo 1982lo'i zla lnga pa'i tshes lnga nyin rdzong srid nas chos sgo phyes te 'bo khri tsho chung gi gtso bo grwa rgan rdo rje blo gros bskos/de'i rjes su pad+ma dbang grags so/ /dgon pa rang gi lo rgyus las dgon du rgyun sdod grwa grangs lnga tsam dang rgan rdo rje blo gros kyang gshegs tshul bcas gsal/ dgon 'di bdag po med stabs 'jig nye'i skabs dkar mdzes dgon pa'i skyabs mgon rin po che nas thugs khur zab mo gnang nas rgyab skyor yang dag mdzad tshul yang gsal lo/ /

dgon pa'i las sne'i skor/dgon pa'i bdag gnyer 'go khrid tsho chung gi tsho dpon rgan pa pad+ma dbang grags las gzhan med do/ /de nas dpal ldan glang nag dgon pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen mo 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rin chen mchog gis spyi lo 2004lo yas mas nas dpal ldan sa skya'i phun tshogs pho brang gi bdag chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin po ches zhal bsgos yang yang gnang ba bzhin sa dgon 'di nyid la'ang gzigs skyong rogs skyor rgya cher mdzad de 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i bstan pa mi nub dar zhing rgyas par mdzad bzhin pa sogs kyis mtshon bla ma 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rin chen mchog gi mdzad rnam bsdus tsam mo/ /gzhan yang dgon 'di'i rten gsum gyi skor dang mchod chas 'cham gar stabs sogs lo rgyus gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /kha non dgon pa'i lo rgyus mdo tsam brjod pa mu tig star la brgyus pa/de yang kha non dgon nam thub bstan nyin byed dga' tshal gling ni bod rab byung bzhi pa'i me sprel te spyi lo 1257char sga a gnyan dam pas phyag btab pa'i grub mtha' rgyal ba sa skya pa yin/76

khyad par sga a gnyan dam pas rgyal 'bong dam sri sogs nag phyogs bdud kyi g.yul ngo kha gnon par bya ba'i phyir btab pas dgon ming yang don gyi sgo nas btags zhes zer srol yod/ de nas rim bzhin 'phel 'grib spel ma byung yang chos rgyud ni ma 'gyur bar dang/la ldan sa skya ba kho na dang / 4sngar grub pa'i skyes chen g.yu sgra snying po dang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ khram mkha' spyod dbang po sogs kyis sgrub gnas ngo mtshar can yang yod pa'i sa cha khyad du 'phags pa'ang yin no//gdan rabs/sku phreng dang po sga gnyan dam pa'i skye sprul du grags pa ngag dbang bsod nams/ sku phreng gnyis pa ngag dbang kun dga'/ sku phreng gsum pa 'jam dbyangs seng ke sku phreng bzhi pacho 'jam dbyangs kun dga' blo gros/ sku phreng lnga pa lung rtogs chos kyi nyi ma sogs byon//khri rabs/dang po rnam rgyal/ gnyis pa chos sku dpal ldan/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro rdo rje/ bzhi ba rdo rje sprul thar/ lnga pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ drug pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan sogs yin/ de nas dge bskos 77

dbu mdzad spyi ba sogs rang rang las bgos ltar go rim dang ldan pa'ang yod tshul mchis so//grub mchod/bod zla dang po'i nang sidhi bum sgrub nyin bcu gsum/ kun rig rdul tshon la brten nas sgrub mchod tshe sgrub dang rus sgrub bcas nyin bdun/ bod zla gsum pa'i nang rnam rgyal ma'i sgrub mchod nyin bdun/ bod zla bzhi pa'i nang nyin bdun la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas kyai rdo sgrub mchod dang rab gnas dpal 'byor rgya mtsho nyin gsum bcas tshogs/ bod zla lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga nas bod zla bdun pa'i yar tshes bar dbyar gnas bzhugs/ bod zla dgu ba'i tshes bcu bzhi nyin nas tshes nyer bdun bar lam 'bras bla mchod dang / tshes nyer lnga'i bar bla ma ston pa'i 'das mchod dang / mkha' spyod tshes bcu sogs 'tshogs dgos/bod zla bcu pa'i nang rin chen 'byung ldan sgrub mchod dang / tshe dpag lha dgu'i sgrub mchod bcas nyin bcu gsum la 'tshogs dgos/ bod zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu dgu nas tshes nyer bdun bar mgon po khro bcu'i gtor bzlog dang 'brel gar dang phyag rgya 'cham bcas yod/ bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer bdun nas nyer dgu'i bar sgrol ma'i g.yul bzlog gsungs nas yul lung la 78

sad ser dang / nad mug mtshon 'khrug sogs zhi ched du tshar 'gro gnad smin bcas 'tshogs dgos//bshad sgrub kyi skor/dge tshul slong rnam pas 'byung 'dul kyai rdor sogs kyi bsnyen pa dang / chag med rnam bzhi rgyun 'don dang / zla ba yar mar ngo la gso sbyong chag med/ dbyar chos zla ba gsum gyi ring la dpe cho'i gzhung don la slob gnyer/dgun chos zla ba gsum la rtsa rlung 'phrul 'khor sogs kyi khrid sbyong bcas byed dgos tshul gsal lo/ /gzhan sgrub grwa sogs kyi skor dang las sne gzhan pa dang rten gsum gsar rnying 'cham gar stabs sogs lo rgyus gzhan las shes par bya'o// spyi lo 1984lo'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bzhi nyin rdzong srid nas chos sgo phyes/ rgyal khab nas dgon pa nyams nyes thebs pa'i gyong tshab sgor tshig khri gsum stong gnang / dgon pa'i bdag gnyer tsho chung gi 'go gtso rgan pa a khu nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang gzhon pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ dbyangs bzang po/ 'od zer bcas so/ /de nas dpal ldan glang nag dgon pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen mo 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rin chen mchog gis spyi lo 79

2008lor dpal ldan sa skya'i phun tshogs pho brang gi bdag chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin po ches zhal bsgos legs par gnang ba bzhin sa dgon 'di nyid la'ang gzigs pa dge bas bskyang ste 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i bstan pa mi nub dar zhing rgyas par mdzad rgyu thugs khur bzhes bzhin pa sogs kyis mtshon bla ma 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rin chen mchog gi mdzad rnam bsdus tsam mo /deng la dgon pa'i bdag gnyer 'go khrid tsho chung gi tsho dpon rgan pa bkra shis chos rgyal yin/ gzhon pa o rgyan bstan dga'/'go khrid tsho chung gi mi sna skal bzang dbang phyug bkra shis rgya mtsho/tshe ring dbang rgyal bcas so/ /gzhan yang dgon 'di'i rten gsum gyi skor dang mchod chas 'cham gar stabs sogs lo rgyus gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /

mjug byang /de ltar thog mar lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar las khol du phyung ste dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rnam lnga'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam bsdus pa ngo mtshar rin chen phreng ba dang / mdo khams tre hor rong pa tsha ba'i yul gru ru dpal sa skya'i ring lugs 'dzin pa bsam 'grub mthong grol gling ngam glang nag dgon pa'i bstan 'dzin rnams kyi byung ba bsdus tsam brjod pa puṇ+ḍa ri ma'i do shal/ nyag rong rdzong gi khongs su yod pa'i sa dgon e waṃ 'dzam gling bkra shis dgon gyi lo rgyus bsdus tsam brjod pa pad+ma dkar po'i chun po/ dkar mdzes rdzong 'og gi sa dgon phur mgo dgon gyi lo rgyus rags tsam brjod pa bsil zer dkar ngo 'i thigs phreng / sa dgon kha non dgon pa'i lo rgyus mdo tsam brjod pa mu tig star la brgyus pa so gas kyi legs byas kyi cha phran bu tsam da lam grub pa 'di ni dpal ldan glang nag dgon pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen mo 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rin chen mchog gis bskul ba bzhin bkod pa dang / khyad par bla ma 'di pa'i mdzad rnam rags tsam bkod pa 'di ni dam pa khong gi zhal rgyun yun ring 81

bsags te ji bzhin brjod pa las sgro skur gyi lhad bcug med pa ma zad/ nga tsho'i mig sngar gyi gnas tshul la mtshon na'ang 'di pa chung ngu'i dus nas da bar mtshan ldan bla ma du ma'i zhabs pad bsten nas smin grol gdams pa'i chos skor dpag med gsan bsam legs par gnang zhing lhag lha mang po'i bsnyen sgrub kyang lan mang bzhugs/ bod rigs las da dung rgya rigs sogs sems can ches mang ba rnams la smin grol gyi gdams pa dpag tu med pa bstsal te dad 'bul gyi dngos po sgor khri brgya lhag tsam gyis rang dgon du bshad grwa btab pa sogs bstan 'gro la phan pa'i mdzad bzang gi byas rjes thun mong gi gzigs ngor gsal bar gyur pa 'dis mtshon te mdor bsdus tsam mo/ /slar smras pa/mi dang mthun pa mi chos rtsa ba yin/ /gzhan don brtson pa lha chos snying po yin/ /kun phan spyod bzang 'di phyi'i bde skyid yin/ /blo khog gzhung drang dam pa'i rang gshis yin/ /lhag bsam can gyi skye bo'i lag rjes la/ / ngo bstod mi dgos byas rjes kun gyis shes/ /g.yo dang thabs kyis smod dang skur 'debs pa/ /ngo tsha med pa'i mi yi rang gshis lags/ /82

lhag bsam 'o ma'i mdog ltar dkar ba'i ngang / /kun la phan pa'i bya ba che chung kun/ / 'phral dang yun gyi phan bde'i las yin na/ /nya gang zla ba sprin las grol dang mtshungs/ /yi ge'i lam du bkod pa'i byung rim 'dir/ /ma rtogs rang blos sgro skur ma byas kyang / /blo dang rig pa'i nus rtsal chung ba'i phyir/ /'gal 'khrul tshogs mchis mkhas rnams spyan sngar bshags/ /sarba maṅga lo//

zur bkod/gsung mchog yig drug dang siji'i phan yon thar lam 'dren pa'i shing rta/srong btsan sgam po'i ma ṇi bka' 'bum las/ a ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/a ye shes lnga ldan lha yi skyabs/ 'pho ltung zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ ma snying rje chen po lha min skyabs/ 'thab rtsod zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ ṇi byams pa chen po mi yi skyabs/ 'gyur ba zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ pad dga' ba chen po byol song skyabs/ glen lkugs zhi nas skye sgo gcod/me btang snyoms chen po yi dwags skyabs/ bkres skom zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ hūm̐ thugs rje chen po dmyal ba'i skyabs/ tsha grang zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ thugs rje chen po'i lta ba dgongs pa phyogs med mtha' bral/sgom pa rang gsal 'dzin med/ spyod pa mnyam pa ris med/ 'bras bu chos sku 'gyur med/ dam tshig dri med rnam dag 'phrin las 'gro don phyogs med/ thugs rje chen po'i lta dgongs yin no/ /rang gi grogs su dam pa'i chos bzang bas thugs rje thugs rje chen po'i chos la mchod cig skyel ma dkon mchog gsum bzang bas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro rgyun ma gcod cig sun mar bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum bzang bas gsol ba rgyun ma chad par thob 84

cig rgyab skyor du lta sgom spyod pa gsum bzang bas nyams su longs shig sdig pa phra mo nas spongs cig thigs pa bsags pas rgya mtsho tsam du 'gro'o/ /dge ba phra mo nas gyis shig ri rab chen po yang rdul phra rab nas grub bo/ /ci byas dge ba'i rtsa ba bla med byang chub tu bsngos shig phyi'i rgya mtsho la mchil ma gcig bor ba mi 'dzad pa ltar yin no/ /ches thugs rje chen po'i yang snying / a ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/zhes pa 'di bas lhag pa med do/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i snying po ma nor ba yin no/ /zhes sprul pa'i rgyal pos bod khams spyi la gdams pa'o/ /zangs mdog dpal ri'i smon lam gyi bsdus 'grel rnam grol nor bu'i them skas las/ o āḥtsū badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi 〉ཿ zhes rigs sngags kyi rgyal pos drangs te gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa'i dgos pa ni rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su skye ba'i rgyu ma nor pa yin pa dang / 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad sel ba dang /mthun rkyen bsam pa'i don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub pa'i dgos pa yod de/ o rgyan chen po nyid kyi zhal nas/ badz+ra gu ru lan gcig brjod pa yis: de la gzugs mchis 'dzam gling snod du chung : 'di nyid mthong thos dran pa'i sems can kun: rig 'dzin pho mo'i gral du 'khod par nges: zhes gsungs so/ /'di'i 'bru don ni/a āḥlha zhes pa ni/ rma ni sku rdo rje/ āḥni gsung rdo rje/ tsū ni thugs 85

rdo rjer go dgos/ badz+ra spangs rtogs bral ba chos kyi sku/ gu ru nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku/ pad+ma sna tshogs 'gro 'dul sprul ba'i sku/ sidhi ni mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub/ hūṃ ni da lta nyid du stsol cig ces pa la go dgos/ 'di'i phan yon ni/ a āḥrgyu ni gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po'i zhing khams su 'pho ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ badz+ra zhes pa shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba rdo rje sems dpa'i zhing khams su 'pho ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ gu ru lho phyogs dpal dang ldan pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi zhing khams su 'pho ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ pad+ma nub phyogs bde ba can 'od mtha' yas kyi zhing khams su 'pho ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ sirnyi byang phyogs las rab rdzogs pa don yod grub pa'i zhing khams su 'pho ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ hūm̐ ni dbus phyogs stug po bkod pa rnam pa snang mdzad kyi zhing du 'pho ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur ba sogs rgyas par gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dge'o// dge'o// dge'o// 86
